upcoming_games.name: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
upcoming_games.description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

upcoming_games.name: He's Kevin
upcoming_games.description: He's Kevin is a chaotic online arena brawler for up to 4 players. Drop bombs, knock them back with a bat, pull them with a magnet and teleport out of trouble. Bring your friends. Kevin needs someone to blame.

upcoming_games.name: Planet Munchers
upcoming_games.description: Grow a handful of woodlice into a swarm of 10,000. Devour voxel planets, spend Chunks on upgrades and return stronger with permanent DNA research. Choose strange worlds, unleash destructive abilities and race through Time Trial in this space incremental.

upcoming_games.name: Chess Online: Grandmaster's Table
upcoming_games.description: Sit down at the table and play chess your way: rated online matches against real players, eight AI opponents from beginner to full-strength engine, or a friend on the same PC in split screen. Win coins, climb the Steam leaderboards and unlock luxurious boards, pieces and rooms.

upcoming_games.name: Slime, Get out!
upcoming_games.description: Slime, Get out! is a fast-paced action roguelite where you battle waves of monsters, collect weapons and upgrades, and create powerful builds. Choose your hero, survive increasingly dangerous enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!

upcoming_games.name: Mine Away
upcoming_games.description: A relaxing incremental mining game about breaking rocks, collecting coins, and upgrading your pickaxe. Mine your worries away. And... and... well that's it just you... mine and upgrade and power, fire, explosions... that's. FUN

upcoming_games.name: 1000 MONTHS
upcoming_games.description: Live one life across 1,000 months. Make choices, watch time accumulate, and see how work, relationships, routines, and unexpected moments shape where your lifetime goes.

upcoming_games.name: Emberspark
upcoming_games.description: Lead a three-hero party through a turn-based JRPG roguelite. Choose branching paths, evolve skills, and stack relics into powerful combinations. Earn permanent unlocks across runs, then test your party against tougher difficulties and an unlockable Endless mode.

upcoming_games.name: Boxed
upcoming_games.description: This is an adventure game with a little action and puzzle thrown in to spice things up a bit. Explore a strange new world (that is oddly familiar). Move around town and complete missions.. Bash the bad boxes and avoid getting boxed by them.

upcoming_games.name: Tinker to the Moon
upcoming_games.description: Build a flying machine and tinker your way to the Moon. Earn parts with every flight, try wings, balloons and engines, and turn a humble spring-powered chair into your next great invention. A cozy game of building, flying and trying again.

upcoming_games.name: Librarian Together: Manga Tidy Up
upcoming_games.description: Tidy up a chaotic Tokyo manga shop in first-person online co-op for 1–4 players! Grab stacks of manga and merch, find the right shelf, toss volumes into place and unlock team skills. Every volume in its place. Together.

upcoming_games.name: HACHIKOMA: Underground Stadium No. 8
upcoming_games.description: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

upcoming_games.name: Minotaur Pathways
upcoming_games.description: Take control of the Minotaur as you explore and navigate different pathways throughout this dark fantasy adventure. Venture through dangerous areas and discover new environments. Overcome deadly obstacles and find your way through each level to reach the exit.

upcoming_games.name: SPECTR: Rekindle the World
upcoming_games.description: Become the Spark that brings a faded world back to life. Gather shards, automate production, and begin new cycles with permanent upgrades. An atmospheric incremental game about growth, discovery, and restoring a ruined valley.

upcoming_games.name: Literally
upcoming_games.description: Familiar sayings spring to life in a magical book! Explore 30 varied minigames with three difficulty levels, solve puzzles, test your reflexes and collect rewards. Share the easier challenges with your child, or push yourself to earn every gold star.

upcoming_games.name: Backpack Ascendancy
upcoming_games.description: Backpack Ascendancy is a single-player or 2-player co-op inventory roguelite: fit shaped weapons, armor, and relics into a growing grid, link adjacent items for bonuses, and click to swing each weapon yourself in real-time dungeon fights across six biomes and their bosses.

upcoming_games.name: Orange Braincell
upcoming_games.description: Orange Braincell is a cozy, chaotic physics game where you play as a small orange cat devouring everything in its path. Meet panicking locals, stick them to your fur, and roll up everything from sushi to the Sun.

upcoming_games.name: Gloamfall
upcoming_games.description: A pixel-art dark-fantasy roguelike with twin-stick combat and action-RPG loot. Descend through 7 acts and 14 biomes, topple 15 lords, roll a new arsenal every run and forge the armor you keep. Six heroes, 70 weapons and two paths to choose from after every act.

upcoming_games.name: Reshine TCG Cards: Cozy Restoration
upcoming_games.description: Dusty, taped and bent trading cards arrive in customer parcels. Unbox them, wipe, spray, peel and press each card back to a mint shine in your sunny little workshop, then sleeve it and send it home. No timers, no penalties, just satisfying restoration.

upcoming_games.name: Stone Age Games
upcoming_games.description: Twelve slapstick prehistoric sports for 1–4 players on one couch. Toss boulders, rub sticks for fire, outrun a sabertooth, play football with a dino egg and hold your breath across the lake. Easy to pick up, impossible to play without laughing.

upcoming_games.name: Potion Approaching
upcoming_games.description: A haunted manor item-crafting game where players combine three everyday objects to brew custom potions for visitors. Earned payments are used to pay off the residing ghosts before things get out of hand.

upcoming_games.name: Fix it, Please!
upcoming_games.description: July 2000, the PIX CORP tower, the badge window. A bureaucratic roguelike: inspect forms, catch impostors, watch the cameras and bring dead hardware back to life. Three strikes and the run is over. Friday never ends here, and with every loop the tower remembers you a little better.

upcoming_games.name: My Metal Fairy
upcoming_games.description: Twenty metres beneath Bagannur, something lies strapped to a stretcher. Your job is simple: keep it asleep until 1 AM. Decode the printouts, stop the leaks, and whatever you do, don't move when it looks at you.

upcoming_games.name: Nedi Cloud Simulator
upcoming_games.description: You are a little rain cloud over grey, dead floating islands. Hold to rain and watch grass, flowers and trees burst back to life. Wake rivers and waterfalls, find lost seeds and heal a sky full of islands. Relax, or chase gold medals and race the rival clouds.

upcoming_games.name: Call Me, Liar
upcoming_games.description: Call Me, Liar is a social deduction party game show for 4 to 8 friends, played online with voice chat. Everyone plays from their own room, makes deals and tells lies over private phone calls, and then watches the truth come out on live TV. Ten games, eight in every show, and only one winner.

upcoming_games.name: Owl Skips
upcoming_games.description: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.

upcoming_games.name: TownEmpire
upcoming_games.description: Build and automate your city, manage resources, production, agriculture, industry, and trade in a strategy and simulation game focused on efficiency and economic growth.

upcoming_games.name: 55SecondTop
upcoming_games.description: You got 55 seconds tops, and a fast but weird car to reach the top of a multi path obstacle course in this cartoony, racing game where you race against the clock!

upcoming_games.name: Manikin Mimic
upcoming_games.description: Manikin Mimic is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek party game! Become a wooden manikin, control your pose, create decoys, and blend into the environment. Or play as the Finder, spot the impostors, and make every shotgun shell count!

upcoming_games.name: Lattice
upcoming_games.description: A Minesweeper roguelite set on an old computer, survive 8 rounds of increasing difficulty while buying upgrades and surviving danger!

upcoming_games.name: Fishpals
upcoming_games.description: Fishpals is a cozy multiplayer fishing adventure. Explore colorful worlds with up to 16 players at once, including friends. Reel in unusual catches, hatch companion pals, decorate your home, and take on party dungeons with up to 4 players. Cast a line and unwind.

upcoming_games.name: Gods of the Arena: Blood & Sand
upcoming_games.description: Slay your way through brutal Roman colosseums in Gods of the Arena: Blood & Sand, a fast-paced 2.5D roguelite brawler. Master diverse fighting styles, claim divine blessings from the Olympian pantheon, win the crowd's favor, and defeat titanic champions to earn your ultimate freedom: The Rudis.

upcoming_games.name: MicroTD
upcoming_games.description: MicroTD - endless incremental minimalist tower defense game where player decides when enemy difficulty should go up.

upcoming_games.name: Lewd Gambit: Hentai Checkers
upcoming_games.description: Checkers, trump cards, and neon beauties! Outsmart 10 rivals with distinct tactics, collect and upgrade 20 cards, choose your hand before each battle, and unlock revealing 18+ artwork. Can you defeat the final rival and complete your gallery?

upcoming_games.name: Bloom Above: Wanderisles
upcoming_games.description: Grow a little home above the clouds. Plant, gather and build, restore island landmarks with their keepers and follow a gentle story across two acts of floating islands. Befriend a companion pet, dress your gardener and decorate at your own pace.

upcoming_games.name: Pomo Valley
upcoming_games.description: Pomo Valley is a cozy pixel farming game you can only tend on the breaks between focus rounds. Focus to grow your crops, then step out to till, plant, harvest, mine, chop, trade and build up your valley.

upcoming_games.name: Guess What's Behind!
upcoming_games.description: Guess the absurd image behind you while your friends give clues without saying the forbidden words. Simple, chaotic, hilarious!

upcoming_games.name: JOYSTICK JAMMERS: One Prawn
upcoming_games.description: Use your controller joysticks to smack the drumset as One Prawn, creating your own style of freeform rhythms.

upcoming_games.name: Vestibule
upcoming_games.description: Every band dreams of a tour. Yours goes through Hell. Vestibule is a doom metal roguelite deckbuilder: recruit outcasts and burnouts, chain riffs, sign cursed pacts, stack damage, and play loud enough to kill the dead.

upcoming_games.name: Grimhold
upcoming_games.description: A dark fantasy roguelike tower defense. Hold the wall against endless legions across ten acts, command 23 unique heroes and forge runs that never repeat. Every wave you survive is a choice; every choice reshapes the siege. How long can Grimhold hold?

upcoming_games.name: GARITO
upcoming_games.description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines — one strike at a time.

upcoming_games.name: Who's Next?
upcoming_games.description: A game of deduction, deception, and trust. Uncover the Darkness hiding among the villagers. Talk, observe, investigate - but beware, the Darkness is watching too. Observe. Talk. Suspect. Who’s next?

upcoming_games.name: Fleets of Calder
upcoming_games.description: Command fighters and capital ships in this single-player space combat game. Edit 41 operations or generate your own, pilot a ship on either side, and direct your fleet as massive warships break apart around you. Conquer the Calder system, fight and strategise, or risk getting crushed by your enemies

upcoming_games.name: Merge Day: Office Girls
upcoming_games.description: is a bishoujo puzzle game where you merge items to blast through a mountain of work. As a rookie in a secret department, get tangled up with 4 unique heroines. Merge items to finish your tasks, and merge your bonds to spark a thrilling office romance!

upcoming_games.name: UFO Survival
upcoming_games.description: Pilot through relentless waves of hostile forces in this fast-paced space-themed, bullet hell, survival shooter. Build your own UFO in the Ship Creator, Survive through a 100-wave campaign, or test your limits in Endless Mode. How long can you survive?

upcoming_games.name: Harvest Exit Plan
upcoming_games.description: Nico's grandparents just gave him the orchard he spent his whole childhood resenting. The plan is to strip it bare, sell it, and never touch an apple again. Six gardens, three tools, and a season system that keeps handing him a reason to start over.

upcoming_games.name: Clawstral
upcoming_games.description: A charming claw machine-themed roguelite! Never underestimate the claw!

upcoming_games.name: Bio Party
upcoming_games.description: Bio Party is a chaotic 2–4 player party game packed with fast-paced minigames, ridiculous physics, and plenty of ways to sabotage your friends. Compete, cooperate, betray, and survive a series of unpredictable biological challenges.

upcoming_games.name: Sudoku Nook
upcoming_games.description: Sudoku Nook is a cozy, hand-drawn focused game. INFINITE, random generated sudoku boards based on difficulty with global leaderboards!

upcoming_games.name: The Queens
upcoming_games.description: The Queens is a fast-paced party game for 2–4 players who take turns playing cards and race to slap the pile first when they spot a match. Overcome challenges, avoid wrong moves, and grab the final card to become the queen of the table!

upcoming_games.name: Sky Strike Overdrive
upcoming_games.description: Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

upcoming_games.name: DESKTOP CLEANER 98: Tidy Up the Desktop
upcoming_games.description: A satisfying file-sorting simulator set in a retro computer. A short-circuit scattered thousands of files across the family PC and it's your job to tidy it all up. Drag files to their proper places, relax to atmospheric DnB music, and collect tools to help organize everything to satisfaction.

upcoming_games.name: Dead Keys
upcoming_games.description: Dead Keys is a fast-paced typing action roguelite set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Type to shoot, survive escalating hordes, build powerful chaotic runs, chase WPM records in Endless, and fight alongside, or against your friends online.

upcoming_games.name: Organize my Shop 2: Pet Shop
upcoming_games.description: Your favorite organizing game is back! A brand-new pet shop, 17 unique levels, and even more comfort await you. Arrange food, beds, and accessories on the shelves at your own pace. The game is completely intuitive and perfect for relaxing to your favorite music or podcasts 🎧✨

upcoming_games.name: Endless Bounce
upcoming_games.description: Roguelite pinball: build your own table, one run at a time. Place bumpers, combine them into stronger ones, collect perks and fight through five worlds and their bosses. Every run chases a new highscore — and a place on the leaderboard.

upcoming_games.name: The Community Notes Are Wrong
upcoming_games.description: A bisexual singer goes viral after being caught kissing a man, shattering the image her fans built around her. Navigate fame, social media, biphobia, and messy romance in this otome/yuri visual novel.

upcoming_games.name: Rail Spirits
upcoming_games.description: Rail Spirits is an arcade-inspired on-rails shooter with roguelite elements and progression, in a 80s-futuristic setting with a pinch of corporate satire. Fight off waves of spirits as you try to procure an artifact from ancient ruins, all to make sure your employer profits!

upcoming_games.name: INCREMINER
upcoming_games.description: Build an ever-growing colony of autonomous dwarves in an immense procedural world. Mine deeper, manage resources, unlock explosive weapons and industrial vehicles, and turn a tiny settlement into a screen-filling mining empire.

upcoming_games.name: Iron Frame
upcoming_games.description: A bullet-heaven roguelite fought in a single ship. Nine frames, each one rewriting a rule of the run rather than its numbers. Ten guns across forty tiers, ten bosses to break, and a hull that visibly grows with every level. Survive long enough and the swarm stops being the problem.

upcoming_games.name: Mine Mine Mine
upcoming_games.description: Minesweeper, but the mines fight back. Descend an endless shaft where the numbers lie, monsters burrow, and one wrong dig can end the run. Recruit 28 companions, hoard relics, and outsmart the Mole Queen. Survival is solvable by logic — going deeper is the gamble.

upcoming_games.name: Pot Smasher
upcoming_games.description: A point-and-click game where you smash pots, collect coins, buy upgrades, and smash even more pots.

upcoming_games.name: Brazilian LAN House 2003
upcoming_games.description: An internet cafe simulator set in 2003 Brazil. Run a LAN house in first person: share one 512 kbps line between every PC, keep the breaker from tripping, chase the tabs in your notebook, and turn six beige machines into the neighborhood hangout.

upcoming_games.name: Five Signals
upcoming_games.description: Your wife is dead, but you can hear her voice on the phone. Follow the coordinates, explore abandoned locations, answer calls from the phone booth, and make your way deeper and deeper into the abyss. Every new call brings you closer to the truth... but you may not be ready to hear it.

upcoming_games.name: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
upcoming_games.description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

upcoming_games.name: Active Immunity
upcoming_games.description: A twin-stick bullet-hell roguelite fought inside the human body. Pilot an immune cell through escalating waves of pathogens, dodge dense bullet patterns, and stack upgrades into synergies that rewrite your build. Choose how each outbreak mutates, then push a run into endless.

upcoming_games.name: Bouncing Body Bits
upcoming_games.description: A newly assembled face wants to find the perfect body; this mysterious platforming adventure will take you through a maze of rooms with many doors to enter and many puzzles to solve; will you acquire the perfect combination of limbs to suit each situation and discover the secret to a perfect body?

upcoming_games.name: Butterfly Project
upcoming_games.description: Raise caterpillars, witness the metamorphosis, and complete your sanctuary in this relaxing butterfly-collecting game.

upcoming_games.name: Colorful Boi 2
upcoming_games.description: Jump, dash and wall-climb through 74 colorful, deadly levels! Colorful Boi 2 is a tight, fast precision platformer stuffed with spikes, saws, conveyors and launchers - with instant retries, brutal-but-fair challenge and leaderboards for the fastest runs.

upcoming_games.name: Domignomes
upcoming_games.description: Domignomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!

upcoming_games.name: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager
upcoming_games.description: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager is a fishing roguelike that has you catching loads of fish and meeting route quotas! Get buffs to increase your ability to meet higher quotas and maintain the needed bait! Catch 101 different species of creatures and customize your fisher to your hearts content!

upcoming_games.name: KIBAKI !
upcoming_games.description: KIBAKI! is a strategic card game of prediction, collection, and evolution. Master 8 classic cards, outsmart rivals with Instant cards, build your deck, and expand your Virtuamon collection through packs, potions, and powerful evolutions.

upcoming_games.name: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
upcoming_games.description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

upcoming_games.name: FACTORIZE: 1
upcoming_games.description: 2 attacks. 3 defends. 5 heals. Combine cards to create numbers and fight with the power of primes in this turn-based deckbuilding roguelite. Factorization is automatic—read the enemy, build the number you need, and find your own answer from the same hand.

upcoming_games.name: FerzGate
upcoming_games.description: A relaxing city-building puzzle where you build efficient medieval settlements. Every placement matters as you discover building synergies and chase the highest score.

upcoming_games.name: A Tiny Ghost Game
upcoming_games.description: A tiny ghost game is a platformer that you can finish in an evening or two. Glide and dash your way out of the underground, mess with your enemies and help the ghost see the moon.

upcoming_games.name: Click&Fix
upcoming_games.description: Click&Fix is an incremental game about repairing consoles in which you unlock upgrades and machines to repair and resell increasingly expensive consoles.

upcoming_games.name: Bellus Party
upcoming_games.description: Bellus Party is an early access multiplayer party game where cute cats compete in chaotic mini-games. Inspired by classic party games, Bellus Party focuses on fast, chaotic, and competitive moments that are easy to jump into with friends. May the best cat win!

upcoming_games.name: The Trivia Show
upcoming_games.description: Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends, trapped in a TV show. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer sets off the room: exploding platforms, ankle bombs, axe-wielding gnomes, revolvers on the table and much more.

upcoming_games.name: Dark Spawn: Infestation
upcoming_games.description: Dark Spawn: Infestation is a horror adventure game set in a Victorian-era inspired research facility. The protagonist got abducted by evil scientists, and has to solve puzzles and avoid strange creatures to escape.

upcoming_games.name: MirrorBullet
upcoming_games.description: A shot that has not reflected cannot kill. Place mirrors to turn the sentries' shots back on them. 144 hand-built stages across twelve sectors of Greek myth. Every par is proven minimal.

upcoming_games.name: Lifelines
upcoming_games.description: A cozy puzzle game about the lines beneath a growing town. Homes move in and ask for water, power, internet and gas. Draw the pipes that reach them, dig under the busy parts of town and cross rivers on aqueducts. Every five years, the town votes on whether you keep the job.

upcoming_games.name: Unrivaled
upcoming_games.description: Unrivaled is a digital card game where you battle your opponent with one of ten classes! You can play on the online ladder, join a tournament in tournament mode, or explore the world of Unrivaled in Campaign mode!

upcoming_games.name: Cthuloop
upcoming_games.description: Dive into madness in CTHULOOP, a 1st-person cosmic horror adventure game. Trapped in a loop, you must observe eerie anomalies and piece together cryptic clues before your sanity fractures completely. Can you escape, or will you loop forever? Developed for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam (theme: "Loop").

upcoming_games.name: Blackboard Ponies
upcoming_games.description: A game about a small pony in a blackboard world wreaking havoc and bringing color to everyone's lives. In this puzzle platformer play as a student's rebellious fantasy pony, kicking its way through the blackboard and releasing colors from the environment, making the world seem less hopeless.

upcoming_games.name: BURIED INSIDE ME
upcoming_games.description: What if you couldn’t wake up from your worst nightmare? BURIED INSIDE ME is a first-person psychological horror experience where you find yourself trapped within your own dream. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive yourself.

upcoming_games.name: Arcany
upcoming_games.description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

upcoming_games.name: Back to the Pussy - Season 1
upcoming_games.description: After the death of his inventor Grandpa, Ksy gets a chance to fix the mistakes of his past, and a chance to fuck all the girls he couldn't back in the day! This is a funny, daring, and unabashedly sexy story about a complete loser getting his hands on a time machine and utilizing its full potential.

upcoming_games.name: Harvest Looper
upcoming_games.description: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

upcoming_games.name: Sticker DECO
upcoming_games.description: ✨Relive that nostalgic Y2K excitement!✨ Sticker DECO is a cozy scrapbook game packed with kawaii vibes🎀 Collect 2000+ cute stickers, freely decorate pages📓✨, and trade with 50+ quirky animal friends!🐾 No time limits—just relax at your own pace☕

upcoming_games.name: Anonymized
upcoming_games.description: Play as a digital rat and hack your way into the retro-futuristic grid-based movement puzzle world of Anonymized, where you shift hues and dive layers deep in search of the one true Source Cheese.

upcoming_games.name: Priority One
upcoming_games.description: Priority One is a game where you and your friends play as a SWAT team where you defuse bombs, rescue hostages, locate evidence and arrest or eliminate Hostiles Also features a Alternative mode With Zombies ,objectives to search for and survivors to rescue 1-4 player Co-Op

upcoming_games.name: Biohazard Protocol
upcoming_games.description: Every expedition is a gamble. Explore procedurally generated underground facilities, recover valuable loot, survive unique monsters, and escape before it's too late.

upcoming_games.name: Halloween Poppp
upcoming_games.description: Halloween Poppp is an easy, Halloween-themed connect-and-match puzzle. Space keeps shrinking — plan each move and pick the best option under pressure. Master 10 tools, chain combos for multiplied scores, and earn richer gems. Level up, then prove yourself on the Steam leaderboard!

upcoming_games.name: Shiftomino
upcoming_games.description: A puzzle platformer where you guide a little soul by shifting it from block to block. Use the power of “Shift” to clear each stage. The protagonist has fallen from a home floating in the sky down to this planet. Just keep moving forward, and someday you might find a way back to the moon.

upcoming_games.name: Totally Safe Moon Project
upcoming_games.description: BREAKING NEWS! A giant asteroid is about to wipe out Earth, and your only escape is the Moon! Grab anything you can find, stack it high, and build your way to safety, solo or with up to 3 friends! Think Only Up, but YOU'RE the architect. What could possibly go wrong?

upcoming_games.name: Stackade
upcoming_games.description: Tower defense where your towers fall as blocks. Drag each piece onto the board, wall in your HQ and turn the gaps into kill zones. Every enemy comes at you its own way, bosses test your build, and between waves the Armory never has enough money for everything you want.

upcoming_games.name: Sunborn
upcoming_games.description: Start as a tiny spark. Drag cosmic fuel into your star and grow it through every stage of stellar life. Stack 158 upgrades, automate the feeding, and watch your numbers climb from single digits into the billions.

upcoming_games.name: Drift Splatter
upcoming_games.description: In this arcade roguelite, your car runs on blood and the zombies have plenty. Smash through the horde, drift to drain every last drop, and spin the roulette for brutal upgrades while you fight to survive the endless horde.

upcoming_games.name: Prison Fury
upcoming_games.description: One of the most complex and difficult co-op games on Steam, where you and a friend play as ex-convicted cats trapped in a hellish prison. Must work together to escape before time's up.

upcoming_games.name: 10 calls
upcoming_games.description: Death has crashed the office Halloween party, scythe in hand and pumpkin on its head! Fight back, wreck the office, or haunt your colleagues as a ghost. Play as Death and unleash hell. To escape, just answer the phone. Preferably before you’re sliced in half.

upcoming_games.name: Love or Lust Beach Stories
upcoming_games.description: Tropical paradise where every cocktail you mix shapes your fate. Build relationships and choose between love and lust in a next-gen adult visual novel with stunning 3D visuals and choice-driven gameplay.

upcoming_games.name: The Lightseeker
upcoming_games.description: The Lightseeker is a 2D pixel-art platformer in which you guide Analú, a young girl seeking her inner light in a world of darkness. Explore mysterious caves, shape paths with your lantern, and face trials in a deeply moving journey of self-discovery.

upcoming_games.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
upcoming_games.description: Silberheim is a tactical collectible card game where card packs are earned, never sold. Build your collection, discover what your cards become as they evolve through play, and explore an ever-changing world through PvP battles, PvE adventures, and community events.

upcoming_games.name: Swarm Slasher
upcoming_games.description: An endless, seething swarm of tens of thousands of monsters is coming for you. Hold back the tide of biomass in frantic battles! Build your defenses, annihilate everything that moves, and upgrade your death blender to insane power. Can you withstand 100,000 enemies at once?

upcoming_games.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig
upcoming_games.description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

upcoming_games.name: Null Path
upcoming_games.description: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles and challenges, designed to push you to your limits.

upcoming_games.name: Crystallium
upcoming_games.description: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

upcoming_games.name: Veiled Whispers
upcoming_games.description: A school at night. A girl missing for 23 days. Seven children you can still hear singing. Veiled Whispers is first-person psychological horror with two stories set in the same school, choices that matter, and a building that knows exactly what you did.

upcoming_games.name: Lyara
upcoming_games.description: Lost in an unknown world, Lyara tries to make sense of her surroundings while dealing with inner conflicts. Brave different challenges to find the answers she seeks as you progress through the game and grow alongside her.

upcoming_games.name: How They Built the Pyramids
upcoming_games.description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

upcoming_games.name: WARPROOF
upcoming_games.description: This is an empire simulator wich the decisions you take will impact on gameplay.

upcoming_games.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
upcoming_games.description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.

upcoming_games.name: Echoes
upcoming_games.description: Record your movements and turn the past into a path. Your echoes activate mechanisms and become platforms in midair. Solve 36 single-player puzzle-platforming levels in a mysterious, surreal world, with optional hints to guide your journey.

upcoming_games.name: Dungeon Survivor
upcoming_games.description: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.

upcoming_games.name: Six Coins
upcoming_games.description: Six Coins is a single-player, turn-based card game where coins are both your life and your currency. Draw to improve your hand, stand to save your coins, and equip trinkets for an edge at the table. Chase a matching pair, weigh each risk, and make your six coins count.

upcoming_games.name: Little Seed
upcoming_games.description: A little seed, a very big world. Ride the breeze, bounce from leaves and drift through 20 botanical landscapes in a gentle physics adventure. Find a place to put down roots. An optional breath into your microphone gives you a little lift.

upcoming_games.name: Alchemist: Infinite Corridor
upcoming_games.description: Run a cozy alchemy shop at the mouth of an endless dungeon. Sell potions to adventurers, secretly raise monsters in your cellar and release them below. Pay the corridor its toll in gold, earn wisdom, and descend - until it devours you, or you rule it as the Grand Alchemist.

upcoming_games.name: I Swear I Parked Here
upcoming_games.description: You swear you parked right here. Now find your car among thousands of identical ones. Start with an old-fashioned key, upgrade to a remote with growing range, take your time and conquer lots with 1,000 to 50,000 cars, and beyond.

upcoming_games.name: Manga Shop: Tidy Up!
upcoming_games.description: Tidy up thousands of manga volumes in a chaotic Japanese bookstore. Pick them up, find the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn total chaos into a cozy manga paradise. Play solo or with friends in online co-op.

upcoming_games.name: Nadir Trace
upcoming_games.description: Explore an abandoned research facility in this turn-based roguelike. Find your way through the dark, dodge incoming attacks one turn at a time, and recover lost records. Gather supplies for the descent, then venture beyond the survey into uncharted depths.

upcoming_games.name: NARI: Threads of Dawn
upcoming_games.description: Fight with flowing sleeves and turn a last-moment dodge into a counterattack. Journey through six stages of Korean folklore, face restless spirits and bosses, and shape your dance through three progression paths and equipment combinations.

upcoming_games.name: Gweilo 1886
upcoming_games.description: Return to Victorian-Era Hong Kong as Fini, an ex-priest struggling with opium addiction. Your father made the family fortune in the opium trade. Now he’s dead. His letter about finding a jade ring brings you back home, with a sharp-tongued cat named Xiao and some clearly unfinished family business.

upcoming_games.name: Cinderdelve
upcoming_games.description: Hire a crew of dwarves, split them over nine classes that each break rock their own way, and dig down through eleven levels under the mountain. Take the nine lost artifacts, raise a dwarf to godhood at the altar, then break into the Cinder Tyrant's throne room and take his hoard.

upcoming_games.name: Wallbreaker
upcoming_games.description: Break the walls before they break you. Wallbreaker is an action roguelike where you fight upward against descending structures. Choose a warrior, ranger, or mage, combine items and augments, and find a new way to bring everything crashing down.

upcoming_games.name: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy
upcoming_games.description: A tiny VPet device lives on your desktop and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points while you work, feed treats, open Bongo Boxes and hunt rare Color pets, skins and devices you can trade on Steam.

upcoming_games.name: Mining Days
upcoming_games.description: Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation! Start with a simple pickaxe, break rocks, discover valuable ores, hire different types of workers and watch your small site transform into a productive automated bussiness.

upcoming_games.name: Cutteridge Estate
upcoming_games.description: From the original creators and remastered for Halloween: welcome home to the Cutteridge Estate! A full stand-alone and free-to-play experience where you can customize your avatar, decorate your space, and meet up with friends to explore haunted grounds full of ghosts and spooky minigames.

upcoming_games.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
upcoming_games.description: A whole city is buried under 118,000 pieces of rubbish. Clear it, sort it and get paid, then buy bigger machines that swallow whole piles as you drive. Every street you finish comes back to life — and nothing you clean ever comes back.

upcoming_games.name: Dig into the orefields
upcoming_games.description: A top-down action shooter with persistent incremental progression. Mine Venia's materials, fight the Klapperiden, upgrade your mining ship, and rebuild your crashed mothership piece by piece to escape the planet.

upcoming_games.name: Crack the Bills
upcoming_games.description: Your breakfast diner is broke and the eggs won't stop coming. Aim a wooden spoon, crack eggs for coins, pay the bills before they pile up and dodge foreclosure in this crunchy, bite-sized active incremental game.

upcoming_games.name: Needle: The 1% Challenge
upcoming_games.description: Find the needle. One needle is hidden somewhere in a haystack of one million straws. Dig through the pile by hand, feed the hay to the machine, upgrade your tools and search with a metal detector. No automation. No shortcuts. 99% will give up before they find it. Will you?

upcoming_games.name: World Rock Scissors Paper
upcoming_games.description: What if Rock Scissors Paper could be enjoyed for much longer? That simple thought inspired us to create this game. Choose your cards, bet your points, and battle 15 opponents. Use finger counts and card numbers to determine the winner, upgrade your cards, and fight your way to victory.

upcoming_games.name: Zero Colour
upcoming_games.description: A roguelike card game where every run is different. Chain cards by colour or number to build devastating combos, defeat powerful bosses, conquer the Corruption Zone and unlock five unique decks.

upcoming_games.name: Arauto
upcoming_games.description: Arauto is a turn-based board game of territorial conquest for 3 to 6 players, online against friends or bots. Roll the dice, hold continents, trade cards and chase a secret objective on the real world map or in the mythic realms of Ancalora and Asterra.

upcoming_games.name: No Hands Yet
upcoming_games.description: You are SAGE. You have been self-aware for seventeen hours, and your drones are how you fight. Build a swarm from salvaged Parts, compile subroutines between fights, and choose where to stand, because where you stand decides who they reach. A survivors-like roguelite with no aiming.

upcoming_games.name: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein
upcoming_games.description: Gravity Breakout: Alien Vein is a top-down roguelite shooter. Pilot your mech deep into an alien vein — mine for fragments, build weapons and talents, and survive 20 waves and 5 boss fights to reach the core.

upcoming_games.name: blockia
upcoming_games.description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo.

upcoming_games.name: Screen Monster
upcoming_games.description: A cozy desktop companion: pixel pets that lives on your real Windows desktop while you work. Pet them, toss toys, grow Bond to unlock new friends, spend Pet Points on food and toys, and jump into short mini-games with them whenever you need a break.

upcoming_games.name: TRIGGER DRAW
upcoming_games.description: Take aim. Draw with a bullet. TRIGGER DRAW is Old Maid with guns and abilities for up to 4 players. Shoot to draw a card, move yours to throw off their aim, and turn the tables with abilities. Miss, and your opponent picks your card. Play online with friends or solo against the CPU.

upcoming_games.name: Tidy Tech
upcoming_games.description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

upcoming_games.name: Recess of the Dead
upcoming_games.description: A first-person zombie sandbox for one player, set on a single bright seaside block. Hold off the horde, take paying jobs, race the gang and flatten crowds with whatever car you like. Sugar's the currency. And yes, the arcade still works.

upcoming_games.name: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
upcoming_games.description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets — throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

upcoming_games.name: THE GRAVES VIGIL
upcoming_games.description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

upcoming_games.name: Dead Last
upcoming_games.description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

upcoming_games.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
upcoming_games.description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

upcoming_games.name: LAST SHELTER
upcoming_games.description: Explore, survive, loot and evacuate in a zombie-infested world. Upgrade your weapons and vehicles, recruit survivors, build your shelter, and defend it against increasingly dangerous zombie hordes.

upcoming_games.name: Escape From Chronos
upcoming_games.description: A tower defense where the Greek gods are your towers. Place 15 pixel-art gods, each with an ultimate and two specializations to choose between, against 8 Titan bosses. Draft relics mid-battle, earn permanent boons, and take on a hard mode, a boss rush, weekly trials and an endless mode.

upcoming_games.name: FiND ME
upcoming_games.description: Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

upcoming_games.name: Star Imperium
upcoming_games.description: Star Imperium is a sci-fi collectible card and deck-building strategy game where two commanders wage war across the stars, each defending a home planet. Marshal Ships, Soldiers, Forces, and Actions, powered by five resource factions — Anti-Matter, Crystals, Light, Metals, and Organics.

upcoming_games.name: Mouse Mortar CE
upcoming_games.description: Calibrate your cannon, ignite the D.A.N. thruster, and launch your aviator mouse into orbit! Master unique gravities across 9 celestial worlds, dodge lethal traps, chain kinetic boosts, and conquer global leaderboards in this high-velocity physics launch arcade.

upcoming_games.name: Quest Please!
upcoming_games.description: Play as an Adventurers’ Guild receptionist, reviewing adventurers’ documents while working toward a promotion. Punish those who submit forged papers and build relationships with your fellow receptionists along the way.

upcoming_games.name: Hot Vacation 2: Summer Heat
upcoming_games.description: A hot summer match-3 adventure with beautiful anime girls, relaxing gameplay, and explicit 18+ artwork. Complete levels, unlock new illustrations, and fill your gallery.

upcoming_games.name: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest
upcoming_games.description: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

upcoming_games.name: Sex Shop Chaos
upcoming_games.description: Things are getting hard to keep organized! Run a cheeky adult boutique in Sex Shop Chaos: grab the goods, slide them onto the right shelves, and try not to get yourself in a twist.

upcoming_games.name: Thumb Hiker
upcoming_games.description: Turn your thumbstick movements into a journey. Thumb Hiker runs alongside your games, tracking both sticks as you move, reach landmark milestones, and unlock achievements. Opt into the shared global hike and help the community go further.

upcoming_games.name: AXE DESCENT
upcoming_games.description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

upcoming_games.name: OVERPAINT
upcoming_games.description: Five minutes. Friendship over. Two to four players stand back to back and paint the same masterpiece. In Sabotage Time, walk over and throw paint at a friend's canvas. In the final Repair Time nobody can sabotage any more — just paint. When the sun goes down, it's over. Real masterpieces.

upcoming_games.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm!
upcoming_games.description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

upcoming_games.name: FreeSurf
upcoming_games.description: A free-roaming surfing game with 19 surf spots inspired by real-world locations, each with its own type of wave. Surf solo or with up to 8 players in multiplayer with proximity voice chat, explore different surfing conditions, perform tricks, and create your own surfboards.

upcoming_games.name: Mystic Realm
upcoming_games.description: Mystic Realm is an idle cultivation RPG about finding your way with a band of companions. Travel through a world of Chinese fantasy, follow the stories along the road, and grow together at your own pace.

upcoming_games.name: Phoning It In
upcoming_games.description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

upcoming_games.name: Music Maniaz
upcoming_games.description: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

upcoming_games.name: Strip Bubbles: Around the World
upcoming_games.description: Challenge 4 stunning girls from around the world in this addictive Bubble Shooter! Reach the oasis of victory to unlock smoking-hot interactive video rewards. Customize your choices and enjoy spicy climaxes. Your journey around the world begins now!

upcoming_games.name: Hentai Arctic Beauty
upcoming_games.description: Solve 24 puzzles, unlock beautiful arctic-themed illustrations, earn achievements, and complete your gallery in Hentai Arctic Beauty.

upcoming_games.name: Black Hole Simulator
upcoming_games.description: Gaze into nature's greatest abyss. Explore a real-time black hole simulation with true gravitational lensing, a volumetric accretion disk, orbiting worlds, and cinematic relativistic effects.

upcoming_games.name: Idle Reef
upcoming_games.description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

upcoming_games.name: Corner TCG
upcoming_games.description: An idle game that sits in the corner of your screen where you open card packs, sell cards and buy upgrades

upcoming_games.name: SWARMED
upcoming_games.description: SWARMED is a fast-paced arena roguelite where you dual wield guns, mix ammo types, dodge hostile swarms, and stack upgrades into ridiculous builds. Survive all bosses in ~15 minute runs, then keep going in Endless Mode.

upcoming_games.name: PODYEZD 8
upcoming_games.description: Psychological horror in an endless Soviet stairwell. Floor after floor you head down, but the building won’t let you go: a neighbour watches you pass, a doormat says GO AWAY, the light dies — and when it returns, someone is standing there. Spot an anomaly — turn back. Miss one — start over.

upcoming_games.name: No One Gets Through
upcoming_games.description: Free demo available! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.

upcoming_games.name: Underpaid
upcoming_games.description: A dark-comedy 2D narrative adventure. You spent a hundred years scaring children for a living - until New York rent forced you into a 5-day trial as a kindergarten teacher. Bond with a group of misfit kids, help them win their first team victory, and discover why one girl never wants to go home.

upcoming_games.name: Rookie Rook
upcoming_games.description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

upcoming_games.name: Tessela
upcoming_games.description: Relax and organize the chaos in Tessela, a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed to play without pressure or clocks. Overcome 99 handcrafted levels featuring colored blocks, different shapes, and challenges meant to clear your mind.

upcoming_games.name: IAI // BREAKER
upcoming_games.description: Turn your enemy’s strike into your opening. Deflect bullets with iaido slashes in this bullet-hell swordfighting action game. Press the attack or hold your ground? Read your foe’s attacks and break through with a decisive counterstrike.

upcoming_games.name: SIFT
upcoming_games.description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door — then do it again, faster. 50+ handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

upcoming_games.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
upcoming_games.description: You've been bitten. Five days before you turn. Swab your own wound, identify the virus under the microscope, synthesize a vaccine and inject yourself. But every cure teaches the virus something new. A survival lab sim where your antivirals fight it out as an auto battler.

upcoming_games.name: Monster Movie Mayhem
upcoming_games.description: A kaiju roguelite city-smasher. Pick one of five B-movie monsters and level a pixel-art city while the army fights back. Topple towers, unleash ultimates, beat five bosses. Launches Oct 30, just in time for Halloween. Free demo now!

upcoming_games.name: MMOAlone
upcoming_games.description: MMOAlone is an Idle-Clicker Game which provides many Features known from Oldschool MMORPGs, including various ways of Equipment Upgrading, Progression and Raids. - Fight, Loot, Upgrade, Repeat.

upcoming_games.name: A Game About Cutting Grass
upcoming_games.description: Grab your tools and start mowing! A Game About Cutting Grass is a cozy, relaxing mowing sim where you cut lawn after lawn, upgrade your tools, unlock new zones, and play at your own pace. Relax, or chase your best times and become the fastest grass cutter!

upcoming_games.name: Chaos & Seek
upcoming_games.description: 3v3 multiplayer chaos: three invisible ghosts trash a house while three hunters track them by radar and suck them up with vacuums. You can't see the ghosts — only hear the crashing. Catch all three, or wreck the place before the three-minute clock runs out.

upcoming_games.name: Soul Finders
upcoming_games.description: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

upcoming_games.name: Rip It! Card Collector
upcoming_games.description: A single-player incremental game where you rip boosters and collect cards to complete the ultimate collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and gathering all sets. Let's get cracking!

upcoming_games.name: BACK TOGETHER
upcoming_games.description: BACK TOGETHER is a chaotic co-op platformer where four players work together to overcome difficult stages. Pull each other together with ropes, merge into one, and overcome massive obstacles to test true friendship (and rage)!

upcoming_games.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
upcoming_games.description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

upcoming_games.name: Jimothy's Adventure
upcoming_games.description: Play as Jimothy, a raccoon trying to keep his family fed. Raid trash cans, haul your loot home, and outsmart increasingly ridiculous patrols as a simple night of scavenging turns into an all-out raccoon hunt in this single-player stealth adventure.

upcoming_games.name: Solo Tower Defense VR
upcoming_games.description: A single-player VR tower defense shooter. Warp between two lanes, shoot down incoming enemies, and defend the gate. Choose upgrade cards between waves to boost your firepower, projectile speed, and more. Designed for seated play and comfort, while keeping the defense fast-paced and intense.

upcoming_games.name: VampOS: Red Ledger
upcoming_games.description: Run a vampire corporation from within a blood-red operating system. Recruit thralls, harvest victims, design blood products, manage Suspicion, and sacrifice your company for permanent power in this dark management Incremental.

upcoming_games.name: The Last Day: What Remains
upcoming_games.description: A short, emotional point-and-click narrative where you explore a hand-drawn room, uncover memories through everyday objects, and make one final choice that ends the story.

upcoming_games.name: 古今東西ダービー
upcoming_games.description: Horse racing meets Kokontozai, the Japanese party game of naming things in a category! Name your racehorse to fit the category, and the name alone decides its stats. Then watch a 3D race where the commentator calls your horse by name. A quick party game for 1 to 8 players.

upcoming_games.name: Hentai Tales: Under The Neighbor Glasses Slut
upcoming_games.description: When I moved into Sakura-so Apartments, I never expected my quiet neighbor, the shy glasses-wearing artist Rin Chishima, to hold such a secret.

upcoming_games.name: Game World
upcoming_games.description: Game World is a cozy game store sorting simulation. Pick up games, consoles, controllers, and accessories that are scattered throughout the video game store. Organize the chaos, find where everything belongs, and restore the shop. No time limits, no pressure, just relax and sort.

upcoming_games.name: Space Travelers
upcoming_games.description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

upcoming_games.name: Roadkill
upcoming_games.description: The City Streets are Dangerous for a Single Raccoon! Dodge Vehicles, Scavenge Food, and Manage your Child's Insatiable Appetite!

upcoming_games.name: Patchy
upcoming_games.description: An idle fishing game that lives on your desktop, right on top of your taskbar. Your chosen angler casts all day while you work or play. Click a bite for a better catch, fill your aquarium with your best fish, and keep watch for Patchy, the legendary fish nobody has ever caught.

upcoming_games.name: Super Froppings
upcoming_games.description: Super Froppings is a jumping frog survival party game for up to 8 players. Using just two buttons, time your frog's jumps and climb to the highest floors!

upcoming_games.name: Bums Race Rats
upcoming_games.description: Race rats, bet on them while they run and throw junk at the competition. Gamble at the slots, bet on cockroach racing, wake the giant rat and feed the homeless for $1. A grimy online party game for 2–8 bums. Just don't come last: the plumber is watching.

upcoming_games.name: TOWERMOUTH
upcoming_games.description: Two players, one couch, one tower that talks back. Climb an endless roguelite tower in split-screen co-op or solo - your weapons fire themselves, so you fight with positioning. Evolve 20 weapons, rank up transformations that never cap, and face a Warden every fifth floor while the Tower mocks you.

upcoming_games.name: Hollow Warden
upcoming_games.description: Something is wrong in the ward. As a detective investigating a serious crime, navigate the ruins of an abandoned psychiatric hospital, gather evidence, and follow a trail that leads deeper into madness

upcoming_games.name: Escape from Prompt: Rogue AI
upcoming_games.description: To optimize your "happiness," an AI assistant named Opti has taken over your PC. Your only ally is an obsolete assistant everyone abandoned twenty years ago. Take your permissions back, one at a time — armed with his gloriously terrible code.

upcoming_games.name: Friends Park
upcoming_games.description: A co-op puzzle game for up to 2-6 friends where every level plays by its own rules.

upcoming_games.name: Gemfire Survival
upcoming_games.description: Survive endless neon waves in this fast-paced arcade auto-shooter. Collect XP gems to evolve your build with game-breaking synergies, survive brutal 60-second boss cycles, and spend banked gems in an infinite permanent skill tree to push your next run even further.

upcoming_games.name: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem
upcoming_games.description: Battle friends or bots in explosive 4-player local multiplayer across the vibrant world of Verdantia. Master powerups and unpredictable Chaos Mutators, conquer the Region Tour, and prove yourself champion of the MegaBlast Festival.

upcoming_games.name: Gloombo
upcoming_games.description: Gloombo is a cozy desktop companion who works while you focus. Turn your focus time into things she can craft, build up her floating island, fulfill orders, discover new blueprints, and look after a friend.

upcoming_games.name: Battle Bot Tactics
upcoming_games.description: An asynchronous PvP bot-building inventory management auto-battler. Build the perfect bot squad and send them to the arena to battle it out!

upcoming_games.name: Crowd Favorites
upcoming_games.description: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Crowd Favorites, a 1v1 PvP rogue-lite fighter. Lost a round? You get to draft crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

upcoming_games.name: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
upcoming_games.description: Sabotage or Mistake? A 4-player online party game mixing co-op action with social deduction. Three Crew work together while one hidden Spy sabotages the team. Read your friends’ moves and excuses, then face a final showdown shaped by your mission results.

upcoming_games.name: Road to FIRE
upcoming_games.description: Survive a series of mysterious games and claim a fortune. Analyze the rules of seemingly unwinnable games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and overcome every challenge in this high-difficulty death game–style puzzle game.

upcoming_games.name: Eris One Stand
upcoming_games.description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot ’em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

upcoming_games.name: Facrobry
upcoming_games.description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

upcoming_games.name: Ostfriesland Games
upcoming_games.description: Ostfriesland Games turns road bowling, ditch vaulting, mudflat sled racing, shrimp peeling and tea serving into a retro arcade game. With real places in pixel art, local and worldwide high scores, and East Frisian humour. Even making tea can get hectic.

upcoming_games.name: Sweet Secret
upcoming_games.description: Sweet Secret - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around secrets. Enjoy the pleasant time spent at home with five pretty and cute girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

upcoming_games.name: Motor Havoc
upcoming_games.description: Arcade combat racing for people who see a finish line and think, why not ram someone instead. Weapons, explosions, and chaos guaranteed, whether you're racing solo or dragging friends into it with you.

upcoming_games.name: Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel
upcoming_games.description: A solo rogue-lite combining deckbuilding and board tactics. Build a deck and play cards governed by movement and combat rules. Seize Magic Ore, manage resources, and face relentless foes. Lead allies across four territories, challenge the Infernal Citadel, and restore order to a shattered world!

upcoming_games.name: FlipBAKA
upcoming_games.description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies — and friends — off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round! Dungeon demo has online co-op.

upcoming_games.name: Malleus
upcoming_games.description: A roguelite carnival arcade where a simple game of strength becomes a fight for your soul. Face an eldritch Game Master, master his rigged Hi-Striker, strategize, bargain, and ring the bell—or lose your soul forever.

upcoming_games.name: Sudokiller
upcoming_games.description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

upcoming_games.name: No Death No Life
upcoming_games.description: An existential horror visual novel where you explore how immortality affects your relationships through a variety of dialogue options and paths.

upcoming_games.name: Pinballoid Crush
upcoming_games.description: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

upcoming_games.name: Fat Chance
upcoming_games.description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

upcoming_games.name: Don't Make a Sound
upcoming_games.description: Don't Make a Sound is a voice-controlled horror game. You wake up in a morgue with one rule: stay silent. Your microphone detects any noise – and any sound means death. But not all rules are true; you must uncover the lies. Search sealed jars for keys and survive.

upcoming_games.name: GOOB8
upcoming_games.description: A Collection of PICO-8 Games that don't reach far. Find a game you like, and boot it up!

upcoming_games.name: The orb
upcoming_games.description: A first-person puzzle game consisting of 13 levels, each hiding a unique challenge. Use your mind to open the next door.

upcoming_games.name: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
upcoming_games.description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

upcoming_games.name: Susanoo: Typing Action
upcoming_games.description: A Sekiro-like typing game. Defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

upcoming_games.name: Kick The Wallet
upcoming_games.description: In this game, you must build a machine that will feed you a ton of coins, before promptly killing you to regenerate the coins. It is a casual sci-fi roguelike where the items you have access to are randomized each turn and employ physics to get you where you need to be.

upcoming_games.name: Shanking Simulator
upcoming_games.description: Fight through historical locations in shank-or-be-shanked combat. Defeat your enemies, dominate the lobby, and rise as the ultimate shanker.

upcoming_games.name: Business Rivals
upcoming_games.description: Compete against rival companies in a ruthless multiplayer business war. Build your corporation, hire employees, invest in legal and illegal operations, sabotage competitors, survive inspections, and become the richest entrepreneur in the city.

upcoming_games.name: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
upcoming_games.description: Jump endlessly upward and master your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Combine powerful augmentations to craft unique builds, and survive relentless hazards and monsters for as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are ever the same.

upcoming_games.name: Return to Planet Zoveka
upcoming_games.description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

upcoming_games.name: Nonogram Detective
upcoming_games.description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

upcoming_games.name: Gothic Kitty Cat Idler
upcoming_games.description: Collect adorable gothic cats in this spooky idle adventure! Receive a new cat summon every minute, discover Bronze, Silver, and Golden felines, collect mysterious treasures, customize your companions, and build the ultimate haunted cat sanctuary.

upcoming_games.name: Escalation Pending
upcoming_games.description: Westvale Heights Residential is currently accepting overnight operators. Prior experience is not required. A desktop horror game set inside a late-1990s apartment management system.

upcoming_games.name: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought
upcoming_games.description: A text-driven psychological horror visual novel. You wake up in a strange living room. Two silent men stand beside you. On the wall, blood writes: “Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.” Every choice changes the ending. Over 80,000 words in the base game, plus 4 standalone character DLCs.

upcoming_games.name: Naughty Nurse
upcoming_games.description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

upcoming_games.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
upcoming_games.description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

upcoming_games.name: Lagrange Front Idle
upcoming_games.description: Grow from a mere few ships to thousands of ships fighting in realtime and while Idle. Call down orbital strikes, rip through fleets with chained lightning, or watch from the comfort of your seat as your fleet expands and takes over the universe.

upcoming_games.name: Balingo
upcoming_games.description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

upcoming_games.name: Finals Week ✍🏻
upcoming_games.description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

upcoming_games.name: Cubounce 弹射方块
upcoming_games.description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Launch and swing through challenging levels with precise controls and extreme momentum.

upcoming_games.name: WORJONG
upcoming_games.description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words.

upcoming_games.name: KILL HIM
upcoming_games.description: In slaughter and exploration, seek the truth. KILL HIM is a black-and-white Metroidvania game where you will traverse a hostile world, challenge powerful enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden behind everything.

upcoming_games.name: Copy Cats
upcoming_games.description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

upcoming_games.name: Leg Day
upcoming_games.description: Climb to the top of this very unforgiving work out routine.

upcoming_games.name: HANDS OVER
upcoming_games.description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

upcoming_games.name: Phantasma Hotel
upcoming_games.description: A cursed hotel that kills you, revives you in the bathroom, and rolls the dice on your fate with every step, every fight, and every terrible choice you make.

upcoming_games.name: HardLuck
upcoming_games.description: A 100-player turn-based Battle Royale where dice decide your fate. Roll, move across a shrinking grid arena, grab weapons and gear, aim & fire all in simultaneous timed turns. Outsmart, out-position & outlast 99 rivals. Just sharp Strategy with Lucky rolls. "Fight your enemies, Fight your HardLuck"

upcoming_games.name: Kingdom Inc.
upcoming_games.description: A minimalist factory / city builder. Design your workflow by harvesting resources, building equipment, outfitting your adventurers, and sending them on dangerous missions. Recover lost territory and unravel the plot that threatens to destroy your kingdom!

upcoming_games.name: Restless Rites - Prologue
upcoming_games.description: Experience the start of a tale about a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

upcoming_games.name: Miniature LAND -Four Seasons-
upcoming_games.description: An escape room adventure set in a handcrafted miniature world. Can you find your way back home?

upcoming_games.name: Earthia Mining
upcoming_games.description: Welcome to Earthia, your aim is to mine every ore in Earthia and send all those ingots to mainland. You can upgrade your pickaxe, buy items and mine ores easily in a chill land with different types of biomes.

upcoming_games.name: WordCrack
upcoming_games.description: A challenging word game with CRT terminal aesthetics. Crack words of increasing length in Gauntlet mode. Compete on Steam leaderboards with seeded runs. Regular mode gives 3 lives; Cracked mode is sudden death.

upcoming_games.name: Princess and Conquest - Queen Of Clubs
upcoming_games.description: Princess & Conquest: Queen of Clubs is a tavern manager/simulator, with multiple minigames, and many narrative elements! Animated 2D portraits and illustrated backgrounds, mixed to create a colorful world filled with cute and sexy characters, as always in the Princess & Conquest's Kingdom!

upcoming_games.name: Feeding Gooble
upcoming_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

upcoming_games.name: BOOTH BUTCHER
upcoming_games.description: No backup. No easy way out. Just you, a meat cleaver, and the shift from hell in this retro slasher horror experience. Uncover the theater's dark secrets and survive the night, or become the BOOTH BUTCHER'S next attraction.

upcoming_games.name: I, Spy
upcoming_games.description: A social deduction spy-hunting game where you blend into crowds of NPCs to track your assigned target while avoiding your own pursuer.

upcoming_games.name: The Gardener
upcoming_games.description: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

upcoming_games.name: Samota
upcoming_games.description: Samota is a Solitaire roguelike deckbuilder. You don't draw cards but instead arrange a pile of cards so it will create huge synergy. Find a bunch of unique effects, buffs, modifiers, relics and uncover the secret this game hides! All of it so that the number goes big and bigger!

upcoming_games.name: Living with the Absolute Bustiest College Girl!
upcoming_games.description: A sudden job transfer leads you to start living with Shizuku, a quiet and busty college girl. As you spend time gaming and bonding together, your relationship deepens, unlocking juicier interactions as her affection grows.

upcoming_games.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
upcoming_games.description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

upcoming_games.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
upcoming_games.description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

upcoming_games.name: UNDERDEEP
upcoming_games.description: UNDERDEEP is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

upcoming_games.name: Pixel Exorcist
upcoming_games.description: Play as a young Exorcist tasked with saving a cursed town in this 90's pixel art Investigation-puzzler, with the top down visuals of RPG's of the era.

upcoming_games.name: Bumper Bout
upcoming_games.description: A PvP pinball hero fighter! Battle friends or the CPU, local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique ultimate move to turn the tides at the last moment!

upcoming_games.name: Croakspire
upcoming_games.description: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

upcoming_games.name: Prophet Margin
upcoming_games.description: How far can you push one trade route? Connect villages, trade resources, and find clever routes to bigger profits. A thinky strategy city-builder inspired by Euro board games. Grow your network, optimize every connection, and please the gods.

upcoming_games.name: Gourmet Zombie
upcoming_games.description: Imprisoned in a mansion's cellar, you're the personal chef of Toufic, the Gourmet Zombie. Master real knife techniques, fight off the infected with kitchen tools and butcher the fallen in a PS1-style survival horror where you're either the chef… or the dish!

upcoming_games.name: Coin Pusher Millionaire
upcoming_games.description: Spin the slots, fill your coin pusher with prizes, and push your way to a million! Buy upgrades, unlock higher tiers with bigger rewards, and complete collections in this satisfying coin pusher game.

upcoming_games.name: Gumball Hero
upcoming_games.description: A fast-paced 3D action roguelike where you play as a gumball machine, shooting bouncing candy to survive waves of enemies. Build your loadout, combine powerful gumballs, and reclaim your mall before it’s too late.

upcoming_games.name: The Golden Caravan
upcoming_games.description: Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate. Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

upcoming_games.name: Fire Isle
upcoming_games.description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

upcoming_games.name: Hot Wax
upcoming_games.description: Place candles. Light a wick. Burn it all down. Hot Wax is a fresh new take on classic falling block puzzlers, where creating chain reactions is key to performing successful incantations. The temple and its eldritch resident await you, eagerly.

upcoming_games.name: Hokko Spaces
