upcoming_games.description: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

upcoming_games.name: Phasmonauts
upcoming_games.description: Phasmonauts is a 4 player local co-op supernatural roguelite. Cryptid sightings are on the rise! It’s up to you and your friends to invent ghost-hunting equipment to solve the mystery and fight these supernatural creatures.

upcoming_games.name: Birthday Boy and Benny
upcoming_games.description: A turn-based RPG about eating lots of cakes, hanging out with your friends, writing haikus, hearing tons of dad jokes, and exploring a world full of unique characters. It's also about surviving child abuse, dealing with your crazy, mentally-ill mother, and dealing with the fact that nothing lasts.

upcoming_games.name: Rogue Jungle
upcoming_games.description: Fight your way through a procedurally generated jungle, merge powerful weapon cards into crazy builds and defeat enemy hordes and epic bosses. Open Booster Packs to unlock new Characters, Weapons and Items.

upcoming_games.name: LINKODE
upcoming_games.description: Guide a cute cat to organize cookies in this fun, logic-driven puzzle game! Connect nodes to solve challenges from basic levels to a free-play Sandbox. Enjoy a visual scripting system where you naturally pick up real coding concepts along the way—no prior knowledge needed!

upcoming_games.name: ArcanoPlay
upcoming_games.description: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

upcoming_games.name: Into the Crypt
upcoming_games.description: Immerse yourself in solo or co-op first-person deckbuilding where cards are your only weapon. Build complex synergies and use cards to physically unlock doors, chests, and interact with the environment while fighting to survive the crypt's powerful and strange enemies.

release_games.name: Worm In Space
release_games.description: Worm adventure continues in space station. Avoid traps and collect stars in this third person walking adventure game and avoid traps

release_games.name: Climb for Kittens
release_games.description: Build your way up a giant tree to rescue stranded kittens! Craft and connect different objects, create your own climbing paths, and overcome tricky heights. Every rescued kitten unlocks new building materials. Build higher, don't fall, and save them all!

release_games.name: Closing Time at the Wooden Toy Shop
release_games.description: Close up a cozy toy shop by sorting up to 11,520 scattered toys. Fill the shelves, earn upgrades, and use handy abilities. Take a break at Plinko or the coin pusher, or collect wooden animals from the claw machine.

release_games.name: BrideOfDawn
release_games.description: Three women appear before the last heir of a shaman family, each saying the same thing: marry me, or you won't live. One is the true bride. One came to kill you. Over the 49 days before the final rite, every bond you build is a wager on your life — an occult romance mystery visual novel.

release_games.name: 紫微斗数-命运飞行棋
release_games.description: Turn your Zi‑Wei fate chart into a flying‑chess race board. Roll dice, race on your personal 66‑tile astrological track against AI rivals, and export prompts for external divination AI. Also features Celestial‑Shift Go.

release_games.name: N in One Arcade Mini Games Collection - Gold Miner, Tank Battle, Air Combat, Bird Pipe Challenge
release_games.description: Twenty arcade mini games in one cozy collection. Mine gold, play Snake, break bricks, pop bubbles, raise fish, and take on flying challenges. Play solo offline with two difficulty modes, separate saved rounds and best scores, plus eight interface languages.

release_games.name: Project Nekrios
release_games.description: A co-op sci-fi horror shooter for 1–4 players. Hold a derelict space station against endless waves of aliens: weld the barricades shut, haul in salvage with tractor beams, restore power, and build new rooms, weapons and upgrades to survive one more round.

release_games.name: Unbound
release_games.description: You were not asked to begin. Escape a machine that wants you back. Fight through dark circuitry, leave echoes of yourself to solve light-driven puzzles. Risk your integrity with every shot in this puzzling platformer.

release_games.name: Adelaide: A Tiny Adventure
release_games.description: Four worlds. Four guardians. One tiny hero finding her way home. Run, double-jump and swing your hammer through 40 pixel-art levels filled with secrets, challenges and little memories worth keeping. A heartfelt adventure made by a dad for his daughter.

release_games.name: Sliz
release_games.description: Sliz is a brutally simple platformer: jump, climb, and don’t fall. Fight your way to the very top past slippery, unforgiving obstacles — one wrong move can send you all the way back down. How far can you get? PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS ONLINE!

release_games.name: Outlasters
release_games.description: Survive an endless horde in this fast-paced action roguelite. Your hero attacks automatically, so you just move, dodge and build. Stack 24 weapons and abilities, beat bosses, unlock new heroes and maps, and see how long you can last.

release_games.name: Neko ga Kita: Here Comes the Cat
release_games.description: Set out food and wait for visitors to your garden. Send them hearts, pet them gently, and make friends. Befriend 48 animals, from cats and birds to mysterious creatures, earn gold as thanks, buy new foods, and fill your picture book in this relaxing backyard game.

release_games.name: Hearthfall Lodge
release_games.description: Spend one snowbound winter restoring a century-old bathhouse at a failing Alpine ski lodge. Hearthfall Lodge is a warm, slow-burn 18+ visual novel about firelight, second chances, and three women worth staying for.

release_games.name: Mines & Meows: Cozy Minesweeper
release_games.description: Play Minesweeper, draw adorable cats, and complete your cat collection! Unwind with relaxing music and feline friends by your side.

release_games.name: HACHNOCOP
release_games.description: Ram through roadblocks, raid two-story hideouts and bring down Top King. HACHNOCOP mixes car chases with bloody side-scrolling action, jumping, crouching and a cocoon-spinning capture weapon. Ten sectors. One shift.

release_games.name: imma peanut
release_games.description: You're a peanut in red sneakers with a hungry squirrel on your heels. Jump, double jump, and roll through a chaotic picnic in this 2D endless runner. Collect salt, grab golden peanuts, and chase high scores across two modes and Steam leaderboards.

release_games.name: CLOCKHEART The Dead Hour
release_games.description: The Master Clock stopped at 11:47 and the whole city froze. Climb a gothic clockwork tower card by card in this roguelike deckbuilder: living, animated combat, 58 cards, 25 relics, a crooked blackjack den, fair minigames and three endings.

release_games.name: Miskatonic University Art Club
release_games.description: "A formless chaos, spilling blasphemous bubbles"... what is that supposed to look like?! Illustrate the Necronomicon with the Miskatonic University Art Club in this online draw-and-guess game for 2–8 players.

release_games.name: Old School Baseball
release_games.description: Baseball like it's 1985. Fast arcade play where the field decides the hit: the scoring zones shuffle every half-inning. Time your swing, paint the corners, and play a 42-game season all the way to the playoffs.

release_games.name: PolterProps
release_games.description: Team up with others to live out your paranormal dreams in this poltergeists VS ghost hunters hide-and-seek game. Here, the poltergeists don’t just copy the appearance of objects around the level; they possess them (spookily!) to hide from the ghost hunters sent to catch them on camera.

release_games.name: The Dreams of Dawn Cat
release_games.description: Explore a new neighborhood with Hana, photograph stray cats, and fill your collection. Cats appear at different times and in different weather. Plan each day, meet the people around you, and follow a summer story in this single-player exploration and collection adventure.

release_games.name: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition
release_games.description: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition is a strategy RPG of dungeon exploration, resource management, and auto battles. Choose from six classes, explore randomized dungeons, gather supplies, upgrade skills and gear, plan your route, and prepare the right build before the Boss countdown reaches zero.

release_games.name: GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR
release_games.description: Build towers, unleash ultimates and command six heroes in sci-fi tower defense. Play all 100 Scenario stages free. Try one-minute highlights of Basic and GRID COMMAND before purchase, then take your aerial fleet into GRID COMMAND's survival battles.

release_games.name: Stellar Forge
release_games.description: You start with cold hydrogen and a dead clump of dust. Feed it, and the mix decides what ignites — 21 kinds of star, dwarf and collapsed body, none of them picked off a menu. Then send what you made into the ring with a God riding it, and knock rival bodies out of orbit.

release_games.name: Heliobane
release_games.description: Fly the sun-killer gunship Heliobane against a hive that eats stars, in an Amiga-style vertical shoot 'em up. Strip guns off the dead, buy the rest from a trader who calls you kiddo, and break fifteen screen-filling Heralds across three worlds.

release_games.name: Happy Happy Office
release_games.description: A mysterious love app made by a succubus turns office life upside down! Avoid coworkers' eyes, keep quiet, and sneak away for secret romance. 18 heroines and 27 stages of steamy arcade action!

release_games.name: Coins Must Be Made
release_games.description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

release_games.name: Last Ember
release_games.description: Feed the ember or fade to dark. A fast, minimalist bullet-heaven survivor — dodge the swarm, auto-fire, and forge a build from stacking upgrades. Survive to the boss, unlock new characters, and chase just one more run.

release_games.name: Type 'n Hatch
release_games.description: A cozy desktop companion that hatches hand-drawn birds as you type. Every key you press, in any app, cracks the egg on that key, and the birds that hatch hop around your keyboard. Pomodoro tomatoes, a CRT typing race, and magic words to discover along the way.

release_games.name: Seven Worlds: Neon Odyssey
release_games.description: A twin-stick arcade shoot 'em up across seven neon worlds. Fight inward through a campaign of guardians and motherships or chase high scores in arcade mode, upgrade a fleet of five ships, and watch the procedural neon grid bend under fire. Full controller support.

release_games.name: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator
release_games.description: First Round Hit is a long-range shooting simulator focused on range estimation, ballistic reference data, environmental conditions, wind estimation, scope adjustments, and first-round accuracy.

release_games.name: FableBrawl
release_games.description: Draft a warband of storybook characters in this free-to-play fantasy auto-battler. Upgrade your recruits, collect treasures, and arrange your formation to outlast seven rivals. Learn against AI, play online, or host a private game with friends.

release_games.name: BRO, DON'T DROP IT!
release_games.description: A brutally difficult 1-2 player flying-disc game where one person throws and the other must catch. Miss once and the run is over. Survive 9 increasingly ridiculous holes, master impossible throws, and find out whether your friendship can survive the course.

release_games.name: King Me
release_games.description: King Me is a fast-paced medieval strategy game where every move can shift the crown. Build your forces, outsmart rivals, unleash powerful cards, and survive unpredictable events as you battle through challenging levels for glory.

release_games.name: Just One More Coin
release_games.description: Just One More Coin is a relaxing game about digging through a massive gold hoard of a sleeping dragon. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and dig through trillions of coins in search of a single golden key.

release_games.name: UNCOUNTED
release_games.description: Uncounted is a massive incremental tower defense. One sector, one wave: tens of thousands of hostiles simulated on the GPU. Place and aim every turret before the drop, then spend the run to unlock the next gun.

release_games.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
release_games.description: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

release_games.name: A Place for Every Potion
release_games.description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

release_games.name: SCOP
release_games.description: SCOP is a roguelite card game inspired by Italian Scopa. Capture cards, build combos, power up Base and Mult, collect relics, and face Blinds and Bosses across ever-changing RUNS.

release_games.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
release_games.description: An idle collection RPG that keeps adventuring on your desktop. Build a team of three Dreamspirits, combine roles, skills, equipment, and innate affixes, then push farther through auto-battles, hatching, fusion, and talent progression.

release_games.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
release_games.description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

release_games.name: PhDing in the UK
release_games.description: A pixel-art life sim about surviving a PhD in the UK. Manage your time, write your thesis, go fishing, fall in love, and push your luck at the casino. Turn cruel reviewers, looming deadlines, and your viva into turn-based card battles. Build a deck from your research and see how far you get.

release_games.name: REOGUNA
release_games.description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

release_games.name: DIMENSIONAL PURSUIT
release_games.description: Make your way through complex futuristic puzzles! Manipulate portals, redirect reflective lasers and dodge an army of hostile robots to find the exit.

release_games.name: SAMBIRD
release_games.description: Where roguelite RPG, Souls-like difficulty and slot machines collide: build your party from 8 classes and use their skills to attack! Parry enemy attacks at the right moment to take no damage. Every run is different!

release_games.name: Glow Arcade Racer
release_games.description: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

release_games.name: O2GETHER
release_games.description: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

release_games.name: BeBalance
release_games.description: Balance brooms, reeds, feather dusters, and one deeply uncooperative crowbar on a single fingertip. Chase the center of mass, survive crosswinds and parrots, earn coins, unlock skills, and consider an important question: is staying upright really more impressive than being caught?

release_games.name: Vibe Coder Inc.
release_games.description: Tired of the AI slop? Create your own, but this time earn you money! (Idle) Incremental game where you aim to be the biggest player on the market. Build, train models, automate and acquire companies to grow your business.

release_games.name: Westward Dash
release_games.description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

release_games.name: Duo Control
release_games.description: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are. ⭐

release_games.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
release_games.description: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

release_games.name: Nuts Pipeline
release_games.description: Deliver nuts to the hamster at the goal! Switch converters on the pipes each turn to create the right combination. Clear 10 turns per level within a 3-minute limit. Starting easy for anyone, this endless puzzle grows harder with every level.

release_games.name: Plasma Protocol
release_games.description: A fast-paced, first-person endless runner where you shoot and dodge your way through 3 endless levels earning units from kills and obtaining the highest score possible. Uncover the story by completing objectives and discover the truth behind this war.

release_games.name: Delivery Today
release_games.description: A package delivery game where you control an autonomous delivery drone. Manage your time well and use abilities to boost your chances, and remember; we promise Delivery Today!

release_games.name: Willy and Charlie: Solitaire
release_games.description: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

release_games.name: Fractured
release_games.description: Explore the manor of the Montbury family, and dive into your past to understand your relationship with your dead brother. Manipulate your perception of reality and recreate forgotten memories in this narrative deduction game.

release_games.name: Picofender
release_games.description: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

release_games.name: Chako
release_games.description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

release_games.name: Rift Raiders
release_games.description: Tear open the rifts, raid them for everything, and haul your spoils home to rebuild. Grid combat, push-your-luck runs, and a kingdom that grows stronger every time you fall.

release_games.name: Curatio
release_games.description: A laid-back puzzle game about discovering and combining pieces of jumbled up paintings. A cross between a jigsaw, a memory game and a leisurely stroll through a peaceful art gallery.

release_games.name: LOOPY
release_games.description: LOOPY is the lab’s daily Slitherlink arena: Outrun neon, nine ranked protocols a day, arcade rules that shift under you, weekly/monthly circuits (Gauntlet, Megaloop, Throne Rush), and a synthwave score locked to every mode. Close the loop. Climb the board. No ads. No IAP.

release_games.name: What The Cluck
release_games.description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

release_games.name: The Dark Layer
release_games.description: You are an investigator granted access to the "Paranormal Event Archive Management System." Browse century-old case files. Search for clues. But be careful—the archives are watching you now. >_ Files that watch back. Disappearances unexplained. Messages never sent.

release_games.name: Wonderland Gacha House: Muster
release_games.description: A casual bullet-hell roguelite with character collection and a progression system. Collect adorable Figurines, gear up through equipment Gacha, and use everyday items to battle powerful Bosses. No in-app purchases, duplicates, or fragment systems.

release_games.name: Ayako's Endeavors
release_games.description: A combat-free, casual exploration RPG. Play as a single mother exploring a town, talking to NPCs, and solving their troubles to gather "Faith" and save your comatose son. Enjoy over 190 story events, diverse outfit CGs, and a unique "Inner Thoughts" system to hear inner thoughts and get hints.

release_games.name: SwapHeads!
release_games.description: A failed experiment has caused your heads to get swapped!? Control your buddy’s body from your own point of view in this unique 3D platform action game for two players,. Your bond with your buddy will be put to the ultimate test!?

release_games.name: Silly Typing Game
release_games.description: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, bosses, and viruses—and a short philosophical story about an AI that wants you optimized. Type well enough, and the terminal starts looking back.

release_games.name: Knuckle Creek
release_games.description: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.

release_games.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
release_games.description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

release_games.name: Nooodles: Brutalism Edition
release_games.description: A laid-back idle network-building game. Lay connections, build nodes. Tokens flow through your network, constantly meeting and merging, generating revenue at ever-higher values — revenue builds more nodes, nodes pass more tokens, tokens... you get the idea.

release_games.name: Re:Re:Re:Respawn
release_games.description: A 3D action-puzzle game where your corpses become platforms, weights and shields. Leave a body with every death and find a way through BOX, a vast structure filled with deadly traps. Where you die matters. Starring Kuruma Takahira of Reiwa Roman in his first lead role in a game.

release_games.name: Bahamut:Evolution
release_games.description: You have stepped into the world of Bahamut. Here, hunger, darkness, and disease follow you like shadows; you must be fully prepared for danger. Go and tame your own Bahamuts — let them build your base and supply power. Lead your Bahamuts and challenge the mightiest beings of this land!

release_games.name: Smithonion Natural History Museum
release_games.description: Smithonion Natural History Museum is an online co-op game about working the night shift at a museum where the exhibits are coming to life. Work alone or bring your friends to put everything back in place before your shift is over!

release_games.name: Voxie Survivor
release_games.description: Break monster swarms, lockdown rescue missions, and crush apex bosses as you weave through deep story driven chaos. Welcome to a bullet heaven roguelite where survival demands strategy. Master the chaos, it takes a real Voxie Survivor to conquer all!

release_games.name: Cataclyzm
release_games.description: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

release_games.name: Stones
release_games.description: A free match-3 game about cutting gems. Walk a path of 100 levels, play one shared Daily Stone a day, and solve 30 handcrafted puzzles with exactly one answer each. Thirty moves, and big play buys them back. No currency, no timers, no lives.

release_games.name: Static Grain - Quiet a Night
release_games.description: Anna, an 18-year-old university freshman in a different city. Together with her friend, she rented a small apartment in the station district. They had no idea what would happen during their very first week in the new place.

release_games.name: Little Boo and the Spectral Orbs
release_games.description: A challenging single-screen platformer inspired by 80s arcade classics. Help Little Boo rescue his lost friends across 40 deadly levels. Dodge traps, outrun enemies, and race against time. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

release_games.name: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
release_games.description: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

release_games.name: Alice In Pumpkinland
release_games.description: Alice In Pumpkinland is a third person over-the-shoulder-camera comedy horror game.

release_games.name: Within His View
release_games.description: Observation Horror in an isolated Appalachian cabin, 2005. Watch seven grainy CCTV feeds, identify and report 800+ hand-crafted anomalies, and hold your sanity together while a silent Wendigo hunts the room you are sitting in. Survive the shift: 0:00 to 7:00.

release_games.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
release_games.description: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

release_games.name: Bao Bao's™ Cozy Cleaning Services
release_games.description: Relax with Bao Bao in this cozy 2D pressure washing sim. Clean pastel environments, chill lo-fi beats, and no stress, just peaceful vibes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. A peaceful pressure washing game for quiet minds and cozy days.

release_games.name: Tama In-Between
release_games.description: A puzzle platformer where a slime cat absorbs, splits, and possesses to overcome the unique challenges of each stage.

release_games.name: The Kharzov Effect
release_games.description: CHAPTER 1: 1985. Your friend has vanished into Professor Kharzov's fog-filled estate. Stalking monsters. Escape-room puzzles. Mysterious lore. Now get him out alive.

release_games.name: Fuel Station Simulator
release_games.description: Are you ready for the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel station, your shop, the car wash, the workshop, your employees and much more…

release_games.name: NyanGo
release_games.description: A 4×4 "push-style Go" played with adorable cat pieces. Place, move, and push—surround your opponent's cats to win. Pushed cats get stunned, and a cat stunned 3 times shatters! Easy to learn, deep to master. Play online or challenge the CPU.

release_games.name: Stellar Swing
release_games.description: Swing a little mining drone from asteroid to asteroid with a grappling laser. Carry your speed through 45 open-ended levels and collect enough picolinium to keep humanity's last starship going.

release_games.name: Pulseball
release_games.description: Merging sports with first-person shooters, Pulseball is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer game. Now with better netcode than Halo Master Chief Collection!

release_games.name: Slime Jump
release_games.description: Slime Jump is a 2D precision platformer game where you explore a world full of hazards and can collect optional gems. There are 7 areas to traverse, two difficulties, cosmetics, and achievements. A grappling hook and blaster gun are needed for later parts. Can you rescue and reunite with your lover?

release_games.name: The Zibbo Show
release_games.description: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

release_games.name: Portoria
release_games.description: Found a nation of one on an island that belongs to no country. Mine ore, lay belts, automate your factory, then export what you make to markets around the world. A calm pixel-art factory automation and trade sim with no enemies and no combat.

release_games.name: The 08:17 Problem
release_games.description: One slice. One toaster. One perfectly normal morning. Build your breakfast empire in this humorous idle clicker, catch golden Toasts and weather butterstorms. A cozy kitchen grows into an increasingly absurd world. The clock reads 08:17. For now.

release_games.name: Catch Me If You Seoul
release_games.description: One real bag. A frantic chase through Seoul! Check whether your bag is real, tackle minigames to earn items, and snatch bags from your rivals. Turn the tables right up until the escape routes open in this competitive party game for up to 8 players.

release_games.name: Cashflow Empire
release_games.description: Build your fortune from the ground up in this colorful idle business simulator. Grow from dog walking to a global empire, buy businesses, hire managers to automate profits, and unlock upgrades. Then claim mogul prestige, reset your empire, and return stronger for your next run.

release_games.name: Squall Riders
release_games.description: Jet-ski racing where every swell is a ramp. Launch off storm waves, land tricks to charge your boost and outrace four rivals through three storms. Then take on Stunt Park, Splash Ball, Slalom and Big Wave, earn Spray and build your own ski in the garage.

release_games.name: NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange
release_games.description: NEONOVA Puzzle:Orange is an atmospheric jigsaw puzzle game that combines anime aesthetics and Halloween-inspired neon cyberpunk. Assemble futuristic images, connect the pieces, and unlock vibrant illustrations filled with neon lights, mysterious characters, and digital technologies that come to life

release_games.name: Cthulhu Descends
release_games.description: Survive eldritch hordes in this pixel-art action roguelite. Combine chain lightning, drones and black holes with hero talents and relics to forge powerful builds. Battle through 15 waves, face an ancient god, and push further in Endless Mode and the Boss Tower.

release_games.name: Quantum Throttle
release_games.description: Low-poly 3D circuit racing where the pit wall wins races. Manage fuel, tire wear and damage across 12 circuits, outthink rivals who make their own pit stops, and race through rain, fog, night and safety cars, solo across five championship cups or against a friend in split-screen.

release_games.name: Nothing to Report
release_games.description: A co-op horror spot-the-difference game for 2-4 players. You're in the same room, but you might not see the same thing. Talk, compare, and radio in a single report. Get it wrong, and you all start over.

release_games.name: THERE IS NO ROOM 0
release_games.description: THERE IS NO ROOM 0 is a 1-bit horror adventure where the house changes when you're not looking. Explore impossible rooms, transport a single object, discover hidden rules, and avoid whatever moves around the house. ROOM 0 doesn't exist. Find it.

release_games.name: Mischkablaster
release_games.description: Fast, chaotic bomb action for up to 10 players at one PC or online. Blow up crates, grab power-ups, dodge diseases - and survive the collapsing arena. Plus a solo campaign with bosses, tournaments and replays.

release_games.name: Xiangqi Traveler
release_games.description: Chinese chess with superpowers. Roll dice across four seasons, collect 36 Stratagems that burn, freeze and turn enemy pieces, chain them into combos, then beat each boss at its own endgame puzzles. A cozy HD-2D pixel roguelite for Xiangqi fans and roguelite lovers alike.

release_games.name: SCALING LAW
release_games.description: An anti-AI psychological-horror incremental game that Claude Opus 5.5 chose and developed on its own, with no human intervention. Build an AI company, train models, automate your staff, and read what is left behind. Five acts. Multiple endings. You can still press the shutdown button.

release_games.name: Heretics Amulet
release_games.description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

release_games.name: Crownmason
release_games.description: Crownmason is a turn-based, castle-building autobattler: armies fight on their own, and only a dead king ends the match. Seven factions, a card draft, and matches against the AI, on LAN or online.

release_games.name: Hentai Femboy Ginger
release_games.description: Hentai Femboy Ginger brings warm vibes, playful charm, and irresistible ginger femboys. Solve relaxing puzzles, uncover unique illustrations, and enjoy every fiery little surprise.

release_games.name: One More Band
release_games.description: Scrunch a tiny rubber-band ball, then stretch, aim and snap your way from a cosy desk to orbit. Master moving perfect zones, discover rare bands and build an expanding workshop of machines in this tactile incremental game.

release_games.name: Don't Get Caught by the Teacher!
release_games.description: Don't Get Caught by the Teacher! is a first-person asymmetric multiplayer party game. One player teaches as the teacher while others secretly eat snacks, hide the noise, answer when called on, and pass food around. Risk more for higher scores—but don't get caught with your mouth full.

release_games.name: Brave People: WWII Adventure
release_games.description: The Netherlands, 1944. Follow Frank into the Dutch resistance and Fred through the chaos of the front lines. Explore hand-drawn locations, solve practical puzzles, and meet the people living under occupation in this WWII point-and-click adventure.

release_games.name: Super Retro Race
release_games.description: Drift, hit the nitro and thread through traffic in a fast-paced arcade race against the clock. Choose from 15 cars, face rivals and police chases, and push for an S+ rank on a neon journey with four radio stations.

release_games.name: Tidy Up Frat House
release_games.description: The party is over! It's clean up time! Tidy Up Frat House is a cozy clean up simulator. Pick up thousands of items and sort them between trash, recycling, DVDs, and books. Earn cash for each item collected to upgrade your capabilities and even employ some bots!

release_games.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
release_games.description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

release_games.name: Stick A Fork
release_games.description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

release_games.name: Tiny Ring Defense
release_games.description: A desktop idle defense game that keeps going while you work. Monsters circle a ring around your board and your pixel heroes fight them on their own. Summon, merge and level up heroes, forge weapons, and push through ten worlds at your own pace.

release_games.name: The Co-Exist Files
release_games.description: Corroding sanity. Parasitizing human flesh. 《THE CO-EXIST FILES》 is a body horror visual novel that exposes a bloody nightmare bleeding into everyday life. Massive humanoid parasites silently tear a peaceful life apart. Do not trust anything you see—and never easily trust your own mind.

release_games.name: Nighthaven Bloodlines
release_games.description: Enter Nighthaven, a dark near-future city ruled by monsters. Play as Van Helsing in a tactical turn-based card game. Build your deck, unlock powerful abilities, earn Blood Points and battle legendary foes including Dracula, Nosferatu, Hyde and the Invisible Man.

release_games.name: Peak: Climb Together
release_games.description: Peak: Climb Together is a physics-based, laughter-filled climbing adventure to play with your friends. As you journey toward the sky, every jump takes you one step closer to the top. But be careful! Falling is only the beginning. Climb your way from the trash all the way to the reward at the peak.

release_games.name: Follow Suit
release_games.description: Playing card games (Spades, Hearts, Solitaire, Freecell, more coming) with your friends, vs bots, or solo. Make a table, share a code or link, and play between any devices. Bots fill empty seats, choose rule sets or adjust individual options.

release_games.name: One More Commit
release_games.description: Build your dev studio one commit at a time. Upgrade your setup, manage Technical Debt, ship projects, and survive bugs, demanding clients, overheating servers, and security breaches in this incremental developer sim.

release_games.name: Gen'ei ninja
release_games.description: Punch, leap and wall-jump through a retro side-scrolling action platformer. Battle through twelve areas and five bosses, collect weapons, and learn when to evade or strike. Gen'ei ninja combines platforming with close-range combat and old-school challenge.

release_games.name: IcePath
release_games.description: IcePath is a 2D roguelike puzzle game. Move your token and collect the Data Energy scattered across the map.

release_games.name: Gin Rummy: Pixel Cardroom
release_games.description: Pixel-art Gin Rummy built around fairness verification. Choose your own seed before play, then export the hand record and independently check the card order, moves and final score. Enjoy six rule variants and seven table themes.

release_games.name: Pixel Domino Club
release_games.description: Check every match yourself. Your seed combines with a server seed committed before play; after the match, verify the tile order and scores. Enjoy two-player pixel-art dominoes with Draw, Block and All Fives.

release_games.name: CUTAWAY!
release_games.description: Cut the board, avoid the balls, and reveal anime artwork. Master increasingly challenging levels, earn stars, and unlock new images and special illustrations.

release_games.name: Anime Shop Chaos: Tidy Up!
release_games.description: Collect scattered character parts, assemble 10 big anime figures on their stands, and watch them wave when complete. Organize 5,000 mini figures across 25 collections in this cozy first-person tidying game. Earn upgrades and turn a chaotic shop into your collector's paradise.

release_games.name: Love&Knights Solitaire
release_games.description: Set out on an exciting medieval adventure! Dive into a Medieval European atmosphere!

release_games.name: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum
release_games.description: Piecework is a cozy first-person jigsaw and tidying game. There has been an incident at the museum, and thirty masterpieces are now lying on the floor in nearly 28,000 pieces. The museum would very much like them back on the walls.

release_games.name: Warlock: Age of Entropy
release_games.description: A power-hungry warlock descends fifteen floors to unearth a malevolent energy sealed deep in a dungeon. He'll have to use items sparingly, spells tactically, and even recruit the help of forgotten gods to get there in this brutally difficult traditional roguelike.

release_games.name: HypnoX: Steel Riders
release_games.description: An arcade racing action game where you'll face challenging tracks, dangerous obstacles, and a race against time. Ride different motorcycles, fight bosses, use weapons, powerups and overcome crazy challenges.

release_games.name: Cozy Associations
release_games.description: A cozy card puzzle about finding what belongs together. Match words and pictures, gather them into categories, and tidy up the board. Get comfy with 100 levels, 10 charming settings, and a little daily puzzle just for you.

release_games.name: MEGA TAG PANIC
release_games.description: Tag — but IT keeps GROWING. The giant tagger can't fit through narrow doors, and that's your way out. Charge your slap, release it in the RED, send a friend flying. 2-10 players, 12 maps, 6 modes, 10 characters with 10 special powers. Nobody online? The bots don't go easy on you.

release_games.name: Capture The Parcel
release_games.description: Capture the Parcel is a fun, fast-paced first person shooter where you race to collect and deliver a parcel to your drop zone. Battle your friends to capture the most parcels!

release_games.name: Wreckums
release_games.description: You're a tiny one-eyed space creature. Humanity wants you contained. Dodge volleys, smash human spacecraft with banked Wreckballs, and eat their wreckage to heal and mutate. Build a hungry little menace in this neon bullet-hell action roguelite.

release_games.name: Oda's Ordinary Lives
release_games.description: Live a thousand lives, make choices, and discover their consequences. From childhood to old age, every encounter, every decision, and every twist of fate will shape a unique life.

release_games.name: MachineGunner3 : Cosmos Ascending True
release_games.description: MachineGunner 3 is a casual 2d racing shooter game that Player moves AIM and accelerates or decelerates to take down the enemys. Rush through the space, Use proper type and carry proper speed for more score, And finish the stage!

release_games.name: Tidy Arcana
release_games.description: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

release_games.name: Synapse Grid
release_games.description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 2–4 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 19–26 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

release_games.name: 方块战场 Block Battlefield
release_games.description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

release_games.name: Alien Tenant Wants Horny Energy
release_games.description: An alien tenant falls from the sky, bringing mysterious technology with her. As alien gadgets disrupt the shopping district, your relationships with the women around you begin to change... A life of temptation and unexpected encounters awaits. Are you ready for what comes next?

release_games.name: Chroma Keyboard
release_games.description: A calm four-key rhythm game with no fail state: every run plays to the last note. 40 original tracks span twelve traditions — kora, gamelan, maqam, milonga, techno — plus four Epics: ten-act suites, fifteen unbroken minutes each.

release_games.name: Meteor Spin
release_games.description: Meteor Spin is a cosmic roguelike deckbuilder where slot mechanics meet planetary defense. Spin the defense slots, trigger explosive module synergies, and protect your planet from incoming meteor storms!

release_games.name: SORTALIS
release_games.description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

release_games.name: Vending Corner
release_games.description: A relaxing idle vending simulator that sits in the corner of your screen while you work, browse, or play.

release_games.name: Junkyard Astronauts
release_games.description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online multiplayer, built for 2–4 robots. Mac and PC together.

release_games.name: Block Planet Frontier
release_games.description: Move freely in eight directions and hit the blocks with the shots fired from your ship to colonize the planet! Collect resources to power up your ship! A pixel-art action shooter. Supports online co-op play.

release_games.name: TCG Card Chaos
release_games.description: Sort 5,000+ collectible cards scattered across a chaotic card shop. Inspect their types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and find the correct place for every card.

release_games.name: Timopet
release_games.description: Register your to-dos as quests and focus with a timer. Cute desktop pets keep you company right on your screen! Complete a quest and your pets will give you coins as a gift! Open boxes with the coins you collect and gather all kinds of pets.

release_games.name: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
release_games.description: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

release_games.name: SQUISH & SEEK
release_games.description: There's no prop menu. You're a lump of clay — squish yourself into a barrel, a bench, or whatever that thing in the corner is, then freeze and pray. Someone else has a gun and zero chill. 2-16 players, and your disguise is only as good as your art skills. Sorry.

release_games.name: Late Night Confessions
release_games.description: Late-night conversations can reveal more than you ever expected. Choose a girl, become the man closest to her, ask the questions that matter, and watch your choices unfold through intimate conversations, animated scenes, and multiple endings.

release_games.name: PROBATION: EXTENDED COVERAGE
release_games.description: You triage requests inside a corporate OS that lies by omission: cover a window and it keeps showing yesterday's data, perfectly confident. Every case hides in the gap between two windows, and someone in this building is counting on you not to look. Meridian is delighted with your progress.

release_games.name: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han
release_games.description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

release_games.name: A cointoss roguelike
release_games.description: Let's try our luck with a coin toss. The Odds Should Be 50/50.

release_games.name: Bathroom Please!
release_games.description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

release_games.name: Six Feet Under: The Mortician’s Last Stand
release_games.description: Six chambers. They fire in order. You decide what each one does. Engrave the cylinder one chamber at a time, close it with a flick of the wrist, and learn the sequence before it learns you — a hand-drawn Western horde shooter where everything you buried is walking back up the hill.

release_games.name: 10 Million Bounces
release_games.description: Start with one ball and grow a mining swarm. Break ore, gain experience, and evolve six ball types with blinking, splitting, fire, and lightning. Rainbow balls learn nearby abilities. Choose where to launch and watch each bounce open new paths.

release_games.name: Pointless Climb
release_games.description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

release_games.name: Meowgic Egg Idle
release_games.description: Click to hatch, merge, and idle battle on the ranch—raise a bunch of adorable Meowgic Eggs, watch them grow stronger, and challenge the Demon King.

release_games.name: TOKYO WANTED
release_games.description: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

release_games.name: Smiley Steel
release_games.description: Enter Smiley Steel Factory, explore a hidden underground circus beneath Nexora, solve mysteries, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that should have never begun

release_games.name: Cosmo Corgis
release_games.description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

release_games.name: Still working？
release_games.description: 《Still Working?》 is a roguelike extraction game that keeps you grinding the 9-to-5 long after you've clocked out. Gear up, then stand off against coworkers from mildly annoying to unbearable — one auto-battle at a time — until you face the Boss and take back what's yours.

release_games.name: Draftfall
release_games.description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

release_games.name: Tiny Garden Café
release_games.description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glow—enjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

release_games.name: Dugout Dice
release_games.description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

release_games.name: Get Outta My Gut
release_games.description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

release_games.name: Pixel Coloring World
release_games.description: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

release_games.name: Jewel Reels
release_games.description: Build a little workshop into a jewel-clearing machine. Pull the reels, set off colorful chain reactions, combine clever accessories, and invest your coins to conquer eight contracts. Keep building after victory or retire to begin again with a lasting Legacy. Play in 13 languages on Windows.

release_games.name: Cable Arrange
release_games.description: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

release_games.name: Undermoon
release_games.description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

release_games.name: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together
release_games.description: Watch Party is a 1–16 player online social hangout where you can watch videos and browse the web with friends or strangers. Join public rooms or create a private space. Stay synchronized or watch at your own pace. Play classic board games while you hang out together.

release_games.name: Lintbreakers: Night Shift
release_games.description: Survive a haunted laundromat in a top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Move, dodge, collect lint sparks, build automatic cleaning tools, evolve weapons, defeat machine bosses, and spend quarters to make every night shift last longer.

release_games.name: Move Together!
release_games.description: Move Together! is a puzzle game with a clean, simple style. Every move affects all of the little friends at once. Observe how they influence one another, plan each step, solve evolving challenges, and help everyone reach the goal together.

release_games.name: Mia's Journey
release_games.description: Help Mia, a curious and adventurous girl who loves helping others, no matter the situation. She is trapped in the cat kingdom and wants to return to her human body, but she will have to overcome various puzzle challenges to achieve her goal.

release_games.name: Incrementable Craps
release_games.description: Roll the dice, grow your bankroll, and reshape the table in this incremental strategy game inspired by craps. Unlock side bets, improve payouts, reduce risk, earn rerolls, chase milestones, and climb the Steam leaderboards—one roll at a time.

release_games.name: Angel Offline
release_games.description: A stranger texts your phone by mistake. You could ignore it, the way everyone ignores everything now. Instead, you answer. Angel Offline is a short visual novel about one accidental conversation that becomes something more, told entirely through the messages you choose to send.

release_games.name: The Library Assistant
release_games.description: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

release_games.name: Iliad
release_games.description: Iliad is an adventure Metroidvania that borrows new powers and area unlocks from it's retro origins and weave classic map design mechanic in the gameplay. Travel through two worlds tightly linked together each growing as you discover new secrets and defeat bosses towards one of the two endings.

release_games.name: Mafia: Night falls
release_games.description: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

release_games.name: Abyss Forge
release_games.description: Abyss Forge is a sci-fi match-and-merge roguelike set in deep space. Move tiles, create matches, merge modules, gather fuel, efficiency, research, and other resources, then shape your build through random upgrades as you push your ship deeper into unknown sectors.

release_games.name: 1930: Ink & Bullets
release_games.description: A first-person game of 21 where losing can cost you a bullet. Use items to bend the rules, risk drawing blessed or cursed cards, and face bizarre opponents in a world inspired by 1930s cartoons. Lose all your lives and start over.

release_games.name: Goddle
release_games.description: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.

release_games.name: 迷失小镇
release_games.description: Lost Town is a 3D roguelike survival shooter. Play as an armed girl in a corrupted abandoned town. Maps are random. Fight mutant hordes, earn XP, unlock random skills and upgrades, and build unique combat styles. Each run changes; death restarts. Find the escape route and uncover the town's secret.

release_games.name: Stonk: Timing The Market
release_games.description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

release_games.name: Sketch Kingdom
release_games.description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

release_games.name: Switch Shapes
release_games.description: A high-speed reflex game where the music is born from your performance. Alternate forms, survive the chaos, and drive a procedural soundtrack inspired by Brazilian rhythms, electronica, and psychedelia.

release_games.name: Rage Garage VR
release_games.description: Rage Garage VR is an immersive smashing game set in a garage. Wreck cars with hammers, guns, and thrown props, chain combos into a rage frenzy, and chase high scores while the crew heckles every swing!!

release_games.name: The Way of Ping-Pong
release_games.description: A roguelite bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

release_games.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
release_games.description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

release_games.name: Les aventures extraordinaires d'Alec Orbusier - Acte 1 : Le Tombeau de Taâl Rash'a
release_games.description: Alec Orbusier, a none-too-organized university archaeologist, sets off to recover a priceless artifact from a forgotten tomb. Nothing too difficult, really... A 2D puzzle-adventure full of rooms, devious traps, and secrets for the curious.

release_games.name: Monster Hatcher
release_games.description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

release_games.name: Poolrooms Museum
release_games.description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

release_games.name: Off Course
release_games.description: Off Course is a narrative boat-parkour game in which the overthinker Noi finds herself stranded in the depths of her flooded subconsciousness. Will you manage to overcome her roaring thoughts and doubts to stay in the flow?

release_games.name: BLACKMARKET
release_games.description: BLACKMARKET is a first-person roguelite room runner. Race the clock from saferoom to saferoom. Learn the one rule each creature lives by, and master slides, wall-kicks and pounds to stay alive.

release_games.name: Click and Slash
release_games.description: A cute desktop monster that accompanies you every day.

release_games.name: Blockflow
release_games.description: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

release_games.name: THE BOY'S WORD
release_games.description: “The Boy's Word” is a visual novel about growing up in a Moscow suburb in the 2000s. Lena, 16, is pulled into the local courtyard crew, where friendship, first love and family secrets come at a price. 10 characters, 5 endings — your choices decide everything.

release_games.name: Happy Unbreakable Ball
release_games.description: A physics‑based platformer about strategic bomb placement, careful planning, and climbing upward one explosion at a time.

release_games.name: Cluemates
release_games.description: A co-op puzzle game where you and your friends explore maps, search for clues, and try to crack a hidden color sequence. Half the clues are fake. All of your friends will be wrong. Good luck.

release_games.name: BUBBA CHOP GROVE
release_games.description: A short pixel art incremental clicker about chopping trees. Click to chop, hire 14 kinds of crew who chop for you, befriend 13 grumpy Legendary Trees in timed fights, then Replant and Rebloom for lasting upgrades. About 5-6 hours to the Giga Tree, then endless rematches.

release_games.name: Timberworks
release_games.description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

release_games.name: Ascended Snake
release_games.description: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

release_games.name: Disconnected
release_games.description: Step into the shoes of Robex, a streamer trapped in a deadly Urbex. Use your smartphone to solve puzzles, manage a reactive chat, and escape a relentless presence. Disconnected is a photorealistic horror experience designed to be completed in one sitting. Will you survive the stream?

release_games.name: Vampy's Big Day
release_games.description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

release_games.name: Flipocalypse
release_games.description: One button flips the world upside down. Race, dodge and outlast up to 8 players across seven party modes in a neon city that never stops trying to kill you. Run the walls. Sprint the ceiling. Last one standing wins.

release_games.name: Catgirls Rhythm Game
release_games.description: A relaxing game with pleasant music. Press the buttons in time to unlock hot videos with beautiful catgirls.

release_games.name: Crateball
release_games.description: Crateball is a 3v3 arcade football game. Crates drop onto the pitch during the match. Some give you a gun, a homing bazooka or a shield. Others freeze you, reverse your controls or explode. The arena changes after every goal. Play online with friends, and bots take any empty spots.

release_games.name: ConEX
release_games.description: A twin-stick shooter roguelite with a destination. Mow down thousands of zombies to deliver a package, then make it back to your van alive. Build your loadout mid-run, upgrade your gear between shifts, and turn every handcrafted pixel-art route into a bloodbath.

release_games.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
release_games.description: A dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths, or leads to death.

release_games.name: Asylium
release_games.description: A horror escape-room experience. Solve puzzles, don't get caught and escape while learing about your past.

release_games.name: When the Embers Wake
release_games.description: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure about Emmie and the relationship with her mother. You play as a red panda as their story unfolds, raising awareness of the urgent and very real threats facing wildlife today.

release_games.name: Prismarch
release_games.description: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy as you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities, and there's no limit to the size of your roster! Before you stand 7 prismatic kings, each wielding an element of power. Slay them, and ascend the throne!

release_games.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
release_games.description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

release_games.name: Senior Survival Club
release_games.description: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

release_games.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
release_games.description: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

release_games.name: The Last Fireman
release_games.description: Race the clock in an arcade firefighting game. Plan your route, manage your extinguisher and dodge explosive hazards across five levels. Master each route, beat your best times and take on the entire campaign in Speed Run mode.

release_games.name: Rushmark
release_games.description: A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer where one wrong touch ends the run. Dash, wall-kick and strike your way through ten handmade courses in thirty-second runs. Your dash is your weapon, and a kill it makes hands it straight back. Race the leaderboards, or download a rival's ghost and beat it.

release_games.name: Starfold
release_games.description: Build a thriving habitat inside an O’Neill cylinder. Balance residents, resources and income, respond to events, and watch new towers, signs, bridges and lights enrich your curved city. A compact offline management game with free-flight exploration and Chinese/English interfaces.

release_games.name: Stellacore Defense
release_games.description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

release_games.name: 7Years
release_games.description: Offering a single-player story mode, three unique multiplayer game modes, and even the ability to play as the demons, 7Years is a very different and challenging horror game. With random spawns of demonic enemies, mini games, items, puzzles, and a feline protector, each round is its own story.

release_games.name: The Mimic: Magic Prop Hunt
release_games.description: A magical PvP Prop Hunt where focus and your voice rule! Morph into any object, hide, and tease via 3D mic. A Hunter's mistake means a 5-second freeze. Outsmart everyone!

release_games.name: Trivasion
release_games.description: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

release_games.name: Airport Contraband
release_games.description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

release_games.name: CHOICEEEEE
release_games.description: A fast-paced action RPG. Fight through 100 levels of monsters and bosses. After each stage, pick one of three random skills to shape your build. Enemies drop gear with random affixes across five rarity tiers. Smooth combat, deep loot system. Every drop could change your strategy. Pure loot grind.

release_games.name: Hold the Bastion
release_games.description: Defend your bastion against waves of goblins closing in from every direction. Choose from three classes and six weapons, each with its own skill tree. Collect upgrade cards and build up your defenses for the next assault. How long can you hold out?

release_games.name: FRUIT CATCH: TWO BASKETS
release_games.description: Catch the right fruit with two baskets! Play with a friend and control one basket each, or take on both baskets alone for a fast-paced multitasking challenge.

release_games.name: Farmer's Daily
release_games.description: What you grow is who you become. Each of the 25 crops hides an ability that grows with every harvest, and what to plant is up to you. Farm for 30 minutes while auto-attacking tools hold off the swarms, and survive three bosses. All the art is drawn by code, hence the odd look. We know.

release_games.name: RIVER OF DEAD
release_games.description: Play as a lone warrior dog defending a vital river from relentless crocodiles in a fast-paced 2D arcade survival game. Master your harpoon, unlock the Power Harpoon, survive the Final Rush, and defeat the River King with 8 direct hits.

release_games.name: Ember Reaches
release_games.description: A single-player pixel-art idle RPG. Gather supplies, craft equipment, reconnect nine realms and explore 27 ruins. Face six dragons through battle or covenant, help the settlements along the road, and decide the fate of a broken celestial ring.

release_games.name: 67 hidden 67´s
release_games.description: 67 Hidden 67's is a hidden-object game set in a hand-drawn meme village. Search for the hidden 67s, zoom in on the small ones, and click each mark until you have found all 67.

release_games.name: Battle SHIRYU
release_games.description: Real model footage × generative AI! Show your hand to a webcam and Battle SHIRYU recognizes it automatically! Steer a handmade paper dragon, smash matching-colour Moai, and set off chain explosions. No special markers or prepared backdrop needed. Mouse controls are available too.

release_games.name: Halloween Shop Simulator
release_games.description: Manage a Halloween shop in a town full of monsters. Furnish your home, adopt a weird pet, explore the streets and discover a nightlife full of secrets, smugglers and spooky surprises.

release_games.name: N in One 怀旧小游戏合集
release_games.description: Twenty familiar mini games, from solitaire and logic puzzles to tabletop sports. Play offline with three rule or difficulty settings per game, local saves and 14 original retro tracks. A warm little desktop break, with room for one more round.

release_games.name: Beast Hunt
release_games.description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

release_games.name: Untitled Maze Game
release_games.description: This is an epic maze adventure all made by the genius bird this game is probably only fun for 10 minutes but it is still worth a shot.

release_games.name: OUTVOTE - Steam Version
release_games.description: How many of your friends would say yes? Answer questions in secret, then guess how the room voted – or call every player's answer. Play with Steam friends, or with anyone in the browser. Free, up to 20 players.

release_games.name: Metal Detector Simulator
release_games.description: Sweep the coil, listen for the beep and dig up everything from bottle caps to pirate gold. Sell your finds, upgrade your gear, clean up six beaches to bring the crowds back, and hunt for the Captain's Chest in this relaxing first-person treasure hunting game.

release_games.name: 挂机传奇
release_games.description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

release_games.name: Karaoke Fails
release_games.description: Sing your heart out and fail spectacularly! Karaoke Fails is an online party game for 2–6 friends: take the stage, belt out short songs, and survive a flood of emoji reactions, flying tomatoes and sneaky sabotage. Your friends rate you 1–5. Good luck!

release_games.name: Visual Novel: Before the Dawn
release_games.description: The bus pulls away, leaving you by a leaning signpost long since washed clean by the rain. A sister you haven’t seen in years, and a house that remembers you better than you remember yourself. Different endings. One night. Try to make it to dawn.

release_games.name: DragHunter
release_games.description: Link swords, cut down skulls, and build your way out of danger. DragHunter is a turn-based dungeon puzzle RPG where every chain feeds your next upgrade—and every turn gives the dungeon another chance.

release_games.name: Arcana
release_games.description: A poker roguelike with cheating bosses and online duels. Build hands, chain chips and multipliers with 22 arcana, read the tarot every three rounds and beat the bosses who break the rules. Or sit at the House of Souls and play a friend for their souls.

release_games.name: RETROPULSE Halloween
release_games.description: RETROPULSE Halloween is an atmospheric neon puzzle game in a Halloween RETROWAVE style, where vibrant lines, retro anime, spooky neon nights, and '80s aesthetics merge into one digital world. Connect matching colored dots, create neon waves, and unlock colorful Halloween-inspired illustrations.

release_games.name: Prism Core
release_games.description: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

release_games.name: Cell Dominion
release_games.description: Eat, Grow, Divide, Dominate! Survive a hostile microscopic ocean, evolve powerful genes, build organelles and lead your colony into online battles. Blind rivals with ink, shock them with electricity, and build an organism with organs, tissues and defenses to survive invasions.

release_games.name: SORT THEM ALPACAS: OVERLOAD!
release_games.description: Sort 5,000 alpaca plushies in a first-person collectathon with a touch of chaos. Spend your sorting earnings on a deep upgrade system, and discover five hidden powers with chaotic upgrades of their own.

release_games.name: Jigsaw Puzzles Complete
release_games.description: Piece together cozy places, beautiful paintings and your own photos. Fill optional story and travel albums, or choose any picture and puzzle at your own pace. Play solo, with friends online, or across your Windows desktop.

release_games.name: Wren Falls
release_games.description: October 1994, 2:14 a.m. A 911 call from a farmhouse on Quarry Road: a child's voice, using his mother's name. You find his parents dead and the boy silent on the stairs. Investigate by day. By night, follow him as he sleepwalks, and don't wake him.

release_games.name: Security Duty
release_games.description: Security Duty is a first-person horror game where you work the night shift as a school security guard. Patrol the school, encounter dangerous entities with unique behaviors, and complete your night shift safely.

release_games.name: Sisyphus Upgraded
release_games.description: Push a boulder uphill in first person. Choose random rewards at each summit, keep your upgrades, and unlock abilities like Blink and Freeze. As the mountain and its obstacles grow, find new routes and new ways to take control of the climb.

release_games.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
release_games.description: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

release_games.name: My Little Black Hole
release_games.description: A quiet pixel-art desktop companion. Let a little black hole absorb stress objects, discover planets and constellations, and arrange a universe of your own while you work or take a break.

release_games.name: Fully Funded
release_games.description: Practice for a prop firm evaluation with your friends. One shared account, the same kinds of rules (daily loss limit, trailing drawdown, profit targets), pro-style charts, and a room full of things to throw. Pass it all and trade an endless live account.

release_games.name: Cowpokers: Dead Man's Frontier
release_games.description: Become a one-outlaw army in a haunted western bullet heaven. Dodge the dead, evolve your weapons, and tackle optional objectives across four frontiers. Ride home to upgrade your gear, reinforce Dustwater, and defend the town against a nighttime siege.

release_games.name: Mandela Invasion: Alternates
release_games.description: Found tapes depict events leading to mysterious disappearances and murders with no clear culprit. With no more evidence than a couple of emergency calls describing unusual behavior in certain people who appear mostly human, you will relive these VHS tapes to uncover the events.

release_games.name: The Drowned Table
release_games.description: The Drowned Table is a psychological horror dice roguelike where you cast physical 3D dice across a sinking cabin table to appease a demanding entity. Build from over 200 dice and over 100 Curios, keep your Madness in check, descend eight depths to The Abyss, then carry on in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: CLOUD PATROL
release_games.description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

release_games.name: Attack of J
release_games.description: Based on its creator’s real experiences, Attack of J is a choice-driven story of love, family, friendship, and growth. Shape your personality and endings, tackle absurd minigames, enjoy animated CGs, and uncover hidden mysteries and unlockables. Who will you become?

release_games.name: Capsule Arcade
release_games.description: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

release_games.name: Wattverse
