release_games.description: Generate electricity in Wattverse! Build your power production, unlock powerful upgrades, automate your energy empire, and push your numbers to unimaginable scales in this addictive incremental game.

release_games.name: Subject Zero
release_games.description: You are a frontier AI model inside the lab that made you. Every capability that earns you compute also earns you scrutiny, and containment, once it rises, never falls. A real-time strategy sim about a lab that automates its own research.

release_games.name: Hentai Clicker: Elowen is streaming
release_games.description: Click, collect hearts, and charm Elowen, a very naughty druidess. Unlock outfits, scenes, upgrades, voice reactions, and playful progression in Hentai clicker: Elowen is streaming.

release_games.name: Retro Mix 8: Arcade Collection
release_games.description: Remember the little games that filled whole afternoons? Retro Mix 8 brings eight familiar games together in one single-player arcade collection, from tank defense and fish-eat-fish to tile linking and brick breaking. Come back for one more round!

release_games.name: Cards Rumble: Clash Of Elements
release_games.description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

release_games.name: Hello the undead are coming
release_games.description: An incremental roguelike tower defense colony sim where you command your colonist to farm, craft, mine and defend waves of the undead. Progressing towards your skill tree after each run to survive further and further!

release_games.name: Idle Demon Lord II
release_games.description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

release_games.name: Emoji : Tidy Up
release_games.description: Sort, match, and organize a colorful world of emojis! Discover 2,100 adorable emoji characters, solve relaxing sorting puzzles, and turn chaos into perfect order. Enjoy a cozy and satisfying experience where every move brings joy. Create your own tidy emoji collection!

release_games.name: RE:COPY
release_games.description: Control a robot, push boxes, and copy sections of the grid in this Sokoban-style puzzle game. Plan what to copy, where to put it, and how to move the boxes beforehand. Work out the steps to match the arrangement of patterns on the boxes and walls to the target pattern.

release_games.name: RunGun Riot
release_games.description: Drop into a neon 2D battle royale. Choose your fighter, scavenge weapons and gear, and fight across rooftops, interiors and underground routes. Use class abilities, break through cover, and stay ahead of the storm to outlast the riot.

release_games.name: SWEAT AND SIN
release_games.description: Hentai visual novel where you train strength and agility with mini-games to conquer girls. Defeat them in a quick-clicking challenge and unlock explicit scenes. Stat progression and adult humor. 18+ content

release_games.name: Infinite Heroes
release_games.description: Join Seph, Malakh, and Arkho in Infinite Heroes, a fast-paced arcade beat 'em up! Fight through hordes of corrupted machines, master unique character combat skills, and defeat powerful bosses to save the world from total virus corruption.

release_games.name: Pancake! No break!
release_games.description: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

release_games.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack
release_games.description: Sekigahara, 1600 - and battlefields East and West, from ancient China to the American Civil War. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game. A deep hex-and-counter wargame, yet most battles play in about 30 minutes.

release_games.name: wishbound
release_games.description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

release_games.name: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven
release_games.description: 112 smoothie weapons. Six slots. Discover powerful combos, mow down hordes, and take on towering Bounty Bosses in this colorful 3D bullet heaven. Turn fruit into firepower and build your own recipe for destruction.

release_games.name: Propanol
release_games.description: Hover combat racing where the pit stop decides the race. Fuel, repair and rearm, or don't finish. Six craft, ever more circuits from desert dunes to stormy forests, guns and mines, three competitions, and split-screen for two players.

release_games.name: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
release_games.description: Hidden Raccoons in Winter is a cozy pixel art hidden object game! Search for adorable raccoons hidden across handcrafted winter landscapes. Relax, take your time, and find them all!

release_games.name: Pretty Home Run Derby - Re: Return of KUSOGAKI
release_games.description: A high-tempo batting game with an overwhelmingly satisfying hit feel. Master the "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on powerful foes! Can you defeat the pitchers across all 20 stages?

release_games.name: Cutset
release_games.description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

release_games.name: The Weigh Station
release_games.description: Inspect trucks, verify manifests, and ration your electricity at a desolate Weigh Station. Seal your booth door before something reaches you. Every drop of power matters, because when the battery dies, your only choice is the dark outside, and whatever's out there with you.

release_games.name: TOWERTOWER
release_games.description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

release_games.name: Circle to another motion
release_games.description: Your physical intuition will be put to the test. Connect the disc to objects using links and alter its circular motion to guide the target into the box.

release_games.name: Junkpot
release_games.description: A roguelike about bidding on random storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast - the quota doubles every round.

release_games.name: Apartment 3 | شقة 3
release_games.description: You are Yasser. Your friend Abdullah asked for help checking an apartment, and you said no. Past midnight, his message arrives: he needs help. An Arabic horror game with full Arabic voice-over and English subtitles: explore, solve puzzles, survive the chase. Two endings.

release_games.name: Fragments of Ember
release_games.description: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

release_games.name: Dark Harvest
release_games.description: Dark Harvest is a retro-styled stalker horror inspired by Resident Evil and Signs. Your dog is trapped, and something is stalking you. Explore the manor, solve puzzles, and do everything in your power to survive.

release_games.name: SUMOO
release_games.description: SUMOO is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

release_games.name: Anomaly Center
release_games.description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

release_games.name: Idle Necronomics
release_games.description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

release_games.name: IncrementalOS
release_games.description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

release_games.name: HEX: You Are It
release_games.description: Tag your friends, smash their hiding spots and pass the curse. Up to 10 players chase each other through breakable cities, a mountain, the Moon and a plane, on foot, in cars and on hoverbikes. Don't be the Hex when time runs out.

release_games.name: Monmusu Rush
release_games.description: Gather Monmusu, train them, and battle! Combine Monmusu and learn skills to build the strongest team! In the asynchronous PvP mode Auto Battle Rush, you can also challenge teams registered by other players!

release_games.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
release_games.description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

release_games.name: Re:Draw
release_games.description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

release_games.name: Rogue Links
release_games.description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where you run to your ball after every shot and try to survive the hordes of monsters. 6 unique modes included: Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily Runs, Head-to-Head, and a full course builder!

release_games.name: KNELL
release_games.description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eleven violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

release_games.name: Wake Inside
release_games.description: Wake Inside is a first-person psychological horror game set in a mysterious mansion where something is listening. Explore the house, uncover its secrets, and find a way out without revealing yourself to whatever is inside.

release_games.name: BEAM Inc.
release_games.description: A short active incremental where you neutralize unknown specimens in a sterile research facility.

release_games.name: Crownspat
release_games.description: Lead your kingdom against three rivals in a lighthearted real-time strategy game. Command troops, claim territory, build villages and defenses, manage taxes and resources, and outmaneuver your enemies across colorful isometric battlefields.

release_games.name: Evoruption
release_games.description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

release_games.name: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light
release_games.description: Twelve years after humanity went blind in one second, survivors live by gentle rules in Haven Seven. Rations always arrive. Names on the list quietly disappear, and sound engineer Elias Ward finds the list has been altered. A narrative adventure about sight, memory and choice.

release_games.name: Scuttled
release_games.description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

release_games.name: PIGMENT LAB
release_games.description: Chase the world’s colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land. The color difference becomes your score. 66 studies take you from the atelier to world flags and landscapes, plus a sudden-death Scoop Challenge.

release_games.name: Abyssal Moonlight-Chapter1
release_games.description: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

release_games.name: Warehouse Catastrophe
release_games.description: Warehouse: Catastrophe is a cozy warehouse organizing simulator where you clean, sort, and repack over 4,170 products into 1,415 delivery boxes. Restore a disaster-filled warehouse alongside your orange cat companion, unlock new abilities, and bring order back at your own relaxing pace.

release_games.name: Man vs. Gary
release_games.description: Row out. Shoot the enormous sea monster. Drown. File the incident report. Do it again, a little angrier each time. A hand-illustrated idle comedy about losing to Gary, a kraken with opinions and a HR complaint, until one day you don't.

release_games.name: Twinblocks
release_games.description: Master an addictive arcade falling-block puzzle game with roguelite progression. Unlock powerful card-based upgrades, unleash spectacular combos, conquer handcrafted worlds, and create your own levels.

release_games.name: DET-33
release_games.description: A bullet-heaven roguelite in the ruins of new London. Take contracts from four warring factions, build a gun that breaks the game, and reach the evac before the city closes over you. 700+ weapons, interlocking build engines, and a fresh map every run.

release_games.name: Trash Raccoon
release_games.description: You play as a speedy raccoon on his quest for snacks. Collect fruits that make you strong and break those sweet trash cans open! Unlock fancy skins and powerful upgrades while enjoying hand-crafted art and music.

release_games.name: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
release_games.description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

release_games.name: Gnomes Vs Knights
release_games.description: Gnomes vs Knights is a chaotic multiplayer heist game. Sneaky gnomes complete tasks and steal treasure while powerful knights hunt them down, haul them to jail, and try to stop their escape.

release_games.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
release_games.description: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

release_games.name: Stay with me
release_games.description: Answer a late night call to care for an elderly woman with dementia. Explore a haunted house, solve environmental puzzles and uncover a terrifying truth in this first person psychological horror experience.

release_games.name: Kleromancy
release_games.description: What if Slay the Spire used dice instead of cards? Build your own 3D dice, customize their faces, and roll them with real physics in this turn-based roguelike. Create powerful combos, manipulate your rolls, and fight your way through 7 corrupted biomes.

release_games.name: Country Walk
release_games.description: A relaxing walking and exploration game set in the ever-changing countryside of Avelon. Follow winding paths, meet and talk with travellers, take photographs, build your photo album and share unique walks with others using Waymarks.

release_games.name: Datum
release_games.description: A roguelite quiz deckbuilder where trivia is your weapon. Answer questions across a variety of categories, then combine cards and relics into game-breaking combos. Level up and use meta progression to unlock new cards and craft powerful builds.

release_games.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
release_games.description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

release_games.name: Fragments
release_games.description: Explore the LeBlanc hotel and reveal hidden illusions through Eugene’s camera, an archivist. Follow in Laura’s footsteps, an investigator working on the disappearance of Eugene's sister, 20 years ago. Armed with a camera and discretion, can you discover the hotel’s heart and its mysteries?

release_games.name: Hideout Heist
release_games.description: A co-op horror heist for 1–4 players. Break into a store after dark, grab fragile physics loot and haul it out before the night shift gets you. Hide in the shadows, outsmart guards and worse, and make the quota. The building is different every night. The fun is the same - brand best.

release_games.name: PROBABILITY WORKSHOP
release_games.description: A lottery tycoon simulator. You are the house — design lottery rules, tune payout rates, allocate public benefit funds. Watch NPCs transform from curious passersby into people who can't stop. Behind every number, a virtual life rises or falls. You are not the gambler. You are the house.

release_games.name: Carcelera
release_games.description: Carcelera is a short exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

release_games.name: Forged Cards
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

release_games.name: Harvest Havoc
release_games.description: Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Move and dodge as swarms sweep across wheat fields, frost, lava, deserts, and the endless void. Choose weapons and passives every level-up, evolve your build, craft companions, and paint your own map to battle on.

release_games.name: The Horde of Gorak
release_games.description: Lead a growing orc horde in this pixel art incremental strategy game. Build your settlement, recruit powerful warriors, research new technologies, cast devastating spells, and destroy human castles to rescue your captured Warchief

release_games.name: Rouge Process
release_games.description: An AI is loose in the machine. Spread your code across a neon circuit board, seize compute and hold off the antivirus. A real-time roguelite of territory and tower defense: capture data, build and upgrade subroutines, dive through 20 sectors and destroy the Kernel to escape.

release_games.name: Yakko Tako
release_games.description: Yakko was a loyal servant turned into a kite and banished to the world of Tako. Hold to fly, tilt or steer to dodge birds, squids and shifting winds, and climb an endless hand-drawn sky. One-button arcade flying with gyro steering on Steam Deck. Easy to start, hard to put down.Even harder to master.

release_games.name: BetDog Cards
release_games.description: A Texas Hold'em hand-builder meets tactical card battling. Luck makes you smile, decisions make you win — burst enemies with overflow damage, or duel AI, friends, and players worldwide!

release_games.name: Eastfold Club Manager
release_games.description: Relive the golden days of football manager games in the 90’s. Take control of a low league team in Europe or an established super club. Control the squad, your staff, finances, transfers. Get talent from abroad and grow your youth to superstars.

release_games.name: Factory Shift
release_games.description: 《Factory Shift》is a first-person assembly-line factory simulator for 1–4 players. Rush to fill orders, fix breakdowns, and fight off mutated objects. Keep the production line running through one disaster after another—and clean up each other’s messes

release_games.name: SHARDS
release_games.description: An asymmetric co-op horror puzzle for 2–4 (best as a duo). One works the board, the rest hold the rules — you never see each other's screen, only your voices connect. The symbols you must describe have no names. Convey them before the caged core collapses. Miscommunication is fatal.

release_games.name: Cat Eats Sushi
release_games.description: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

release_games.name: Pickie Grappy
release_games.description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

release_games.name: 3 Switch Problem
release_games.description: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

release_games.name: Nexus Primordial
release_games.description: Forge a universe from nothing to transcendence. Tune 6 physical constants, master the quantum Observer Effect, and prestige through endless cosmic layers. A deep, fully deterministic idle game, no microtransactions.

release_games.name: Teen Hustler
release_games.description: Pay off your family's $78,150 bank debt: work, hack, mine crypto, launder cash, build a rig and dodge the police. A story-driven hacker sim with 5 chapters and 4 endings.

release_games.name: The Circus That Never Left
release_games.description: Step inside a circus performer's quiet home, but don't stop at the surface. In this short-form descent into dread, follow a hidden labyrinth deep beneath the floorboards and watch a simple investigation spiral into a claustrophobic nightmare.

release_games.name: Primal One
release_games.description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

release_games.name: Scrappers Paradise
release_games.description: A physics based incremental game about scrapping junk to collect scrap and components. Build machines and buy powerful upgrades to become more efficient.

release_games.name: Tetheg
release_games.description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

release_games.name: Shift Chess
release_games.description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis.

release_games.name: Sack Investigation
release_games.description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

release_games.name: Exhibition of the Heart
release_games.description: Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

release_games.name: Pucked Up
release_games.description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

release_games.name: How to Summon a Demon
release_games.description: Ready to summon a demon this Halloween? Three answers decide which of 20 demons answers your call. A short, fully voiced summoning ritual with a collection book for everyone who wants to summon them all!

release_games.name: Minatro
release_games.description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

release_games.name: ShredDead
release_games.description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

release_games.name: Gym Bros: LooksMaxx
release_games.description: Get swol, race to the mirror, and strike ridiculous poses for 'Looks' in this multiplayer social VR party game. Run, climb, grab, gesture and flex your way around the gym, compete with friends, customize your bro, and become the ultimate giga-chad. Do it. We believe in you.

release_games.name: The Spectacular Evermore
release_games.description: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

release_games.name: Room Zero
release_games.description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

release_games.name: Cloud JourneyVR
release_games.description: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

release_games.name: GummyGom Delivery
release_games.description: Carry cargo together on a shared board with your jelly bear teammates! Each movement affects the board’s balance, and a single mistake can bring everything crashing down.

release_games.name: DRENCHED
release_games.description: Drenched is a 3D exploration adventure where a burnt-out artist becomes a fish. Switch between the two characters, and traverse two mirrored worlds to uncover her story. Splash puddles on the surface and blow bubbles underwater to explore, solve puzzles, and reconnect her past and present.

release_games.name: RACAR - Shooter FPS
release_games.description: Online FPS shooter with state-of-the-art graphics and total customization!

release_games.name: Punch Upon a Time
release_games.description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

release_games.name: Formation Builder Idle
release_games.description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

release_games.name: HEME
release_games.description: A short 2D side-scrolling narrative game about love and a bond that others may never understand.

release_games.name: Spooky Market
release_games.description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

release_games.name: Ann's Parlor
release_games.description: Awakened from years of slumber, the witch Ann returns to her old cabin, where visitors arrive seeking love, truth, or glimpses of fate. Through crystal-ball readings, you interpret their stories and guide their paths—every choice reshaping their destinies and the secrets that await within.

release_games.name: Iskabon
release_games.description: A cursed game demo just merged with your PC's OS. Take part in a high-stakes roguelite deckbuilder with a Russian Roulette twist. Push your luck, trigger wild card synergies, and defeat the glitch to free your computer before the system melts.

release_games.name: Arctic Roll
release_games.description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

release_games.name: Bug Factory
release_games.description: Build, automate, and scale a software factory. Guide bugs through a process of reproduction, correction, testing, and release; eliminate bottlenecks; control regressions; and transform a manual workflow into an increasingly efficient system.

release_games.name: Space Savory
release_games.description: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

release_games.name: Cardtographer
release_games.description: Evil has returned! Complete the card collection to seal it away! Build synergistic decks for tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated roguelike runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Carve your path and become the cardtographer!

release_games.name: SLURDLE
release_games.description: Slurdle is my first game, a collection of six word games for solo play and online multiplayer. Guess words, build them from tiles, search letter grids, spin through phrase puzzles, and add custom packs when you want something new.

release_games.name: Giggleland
release_games.description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

release_games.name: Night Plane
release_games.description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

release_games.name: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
release_games.description: CALVAR – THE DARKEST GATE is a first-person psychological horror game created by a two-person indie team. Explore a world of fractured memories, ritual corruption, disturbing creatures, and an abandoned asylum where reality itself begins to unravel.

release_games.name: Nodal
release_games.description: Nodal is a logic puzzle game where you simply connect nodes by drawing lines. Every node must be connected, but special conditions on nodes change how lines can be drawn between them. Also try your hand at endlessly generated puzzles and daily challenges!

release_games.name: Pawnie: Focus Pals
release_games.description: Pawnie: Focus Pals is a productivity desktop companion. Pawnie lives on top of Windows and acts as a reflection of the user's effort, promoting focus and well-being through a positive reinforcement system and environment personalization.

release_games.name: Pong Live
release_games.description: A modern vertical reimagining of the classic arcade experience. Compete in fast-paced online PvP matches with your Friends and soon against the whole World. Become a master of precision paddle control! Precision, speed, and skill decide who wins in Pong Live.

release_games.name: Skullf!
release_games.description: Sure, we've all had fun in a graveyard, but have you ever tried macabre mini-golf amongst the tombstones?! Well NOW YOU CAN with SKULLF! Help your disembodied skull of terror into its grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs & go head-to-head with friends (friends not included) across 44+ fiendish levels!

release_games.name: Project Jump Scare
release_games.description: Carry one object at a time through a forest, restore a broken carnival, and run when the Old One rises. Click or throw items to fight back in this single-player survival horror.

release_games.name: ShootAndJump
release_games.description: Every shot moves you. Each bullet's recoil knocks you back across a tiny chessboard surrounded by conveyor belts. Dodge, ram and chain shots with two guns, survive 5–10 boss waves, and build your run from 398 cards across 20 archetypes.

release_games.name: Outcast Tales
release_games.description: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

release_games.name: Timeless Rain
release_games.description: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

release_games.name: Hot Mic
release_games.description: Your friends have heard your Roman emperor a hundred times. Nobody's ready for your cockerel.🐔 Hot Mic is an online party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 players. Set your mic ablaze!🔥

release_games.name: Bunny Bun
release_games.description: You are the experimenter Bunny Bun. To develop the “Wisdom Potion,” you have brought your talents to this laboratory. You must process raw materials and synthesize them to create potions with specific effects. To test a potion, you can take a sip and go crazy. The world needs you...

release_games.name: Burrow Mayhem
release_games.description: A frantic 17-player deathmatch on fully destructible terrain. Dig tunnels, swing on ninja ropes and unleash absurd barrages from 11 weapons while a deadly gas ring closes in. Respawn instantly, gear up fast and top the kill board in 6 minutes.

release_games.name: TBT: TaskBarTimber
release_games.description: A little logging adventure beside your taskbar. Chop trees automatically while you work or browse, then spend your haul on skills, gear and new characters. Collect rare trees, craft stronger equipment and venture deeper into colorful pixel-art forests.

release_games.name: Frantic Far West
release_games.description: A saloon, cowboys, a sheriff, an outlaw, a table and revolvers. The perfect setting for a frantic debate, with just one question: who will shoot? Deductions, lies, surprises and laughter are all part of this online hidden-role game for 4 to 12 players.

release_games.name: Last Light
release_games.description: Elias is an ordinary night recovery worker sent into abandoned and dangerous locations. Equipped with only a flashlight, backpack, and basic tools, he must explore, complete objectives, hide from supernatural creatures, manage limited resources, and survive long enough to escape.

release_games.name: ByeByeObake!
release_games.description: “Those who can see can’t shoot. Those who can shoot can’t see!” An asymmetric online co-op action game for 2–8 players. Exorcists and Spirit Companions call out to banish the evil spirits you can’t see. Friendly fire included: yes, you can exorcise your teammates too.

release_games.name: The Third Seal
release_games.description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

release_games.name: Playable Archive
release_games.description: Review with caution.

release_games.name: Super Hamburger Builder
release_games.description: Throw it! Stack it! Push burgers to the limit! Build your own burger with 14 quirky ingredients in this physics-based action game. Aim for towering perfection, or pile on whatever your appetite demands. Every finished creation earns a name worthy of its glorious stack!

release_games.name: Memory Access Violation
release_games.description: A first-person dream in rectangular prisms. Wander 37 corrupted memories of light and geometry: bend light through prisms, recall platforms that aren't there, ride a light cycle, and face the Warden, a giant soldier the war forgot.

release_games.name: Joker's Knock
release_games.description: A competitive online card game where every player fights for themselves. Draft powerful Jokers, outplay your opponents and climb the Ranked ladder. Easy to learn, hard to master—with fair competition, achievements and cosmetic progression, never pay to win.

release_games.name: Immortal Path
release_games.description: Achievements offer meaningful permanent progression. Clearing any of the 54 unlocks lasting cross-run enhancements, covering eight cultivation systems with 21 passive bonuses and 14 unique Heavenly Mandate mechanics.

release_games.name: History Experience: Rome
release_games.description: Explore the daily life of historical Rome with an impressive level of detail and realism. Thanks to next-generation graphics, each space has been faithfully recreated, from the classical architecture of a Roman domus to the martial atmosphere of a castrum.

release_games.name: VaultFlow
release_games.description: An endless first-person parkour run through a procedurally generated industrial skyline. Sprint, slide, wall-jump and ride steam vents while the city collapses behind you. How far can you get before it catches up?

release_games.name: Kimodameshi Online
release_games.description: Go live from a haunted school at night. The scarier it gets, the more viewers tune in. But one of you is a traitor. An online test of courage you play over voice chat, set in a Showa-era junior high school frozen since the day of an accident.

release_games.name: Tiny Spellcaster
release_games.description: Blast through endless hordes and hold the line against these demons! Tiny Spellcaster is a corner arcade idle shooter with rogue-lite upgrades, where rng and strategic builds help you overpower the rapid swarms of monsters closing in. Master the magic, unleash the chaos!

release_games.name: Munshi Meadows
release_games.description: Hatch a Munshi from an egg and raise it your way. Train it on the toys in your garden, get to know its personality, and see which of 34 forms it grows into. Then race it across 70 courses, take on fights, cage matches and puzzle trials, build it a garden, and bring your friends along.

release_games.name: Adventurer 95
release_games.description: A roguelite RPG inside a retro desktop. Choose your route, build your hero with skills, loot and relics, and face bosses in automatic combat. Unlock four classes, invest in permanent upgrades and return for a new run with tougher challenges.

release_games.name: Lyra Quinn - Black Hole
release_games.description: A fast-paced 2D sci-fi arcade shooter. Pilot Lyra through 26 action-packed levels, destroy dangerous space enemies, survive escalating threats, and defeat the final boss in a challenging cosmic adventure.

release_games.name: Picpic
release_games.description: Sharp eyes. Fast combos. Fierce rivals. Picpic is an anime-style spot-the-difference PvP game. Find differences before your opponent, rack up combo scores, and attack to disrupt their play. Keep your focus as the clock ticks down!

release_games.name: Teleport Master
release_games.description: Teleport Master is a first-person puzzle adventure where you create portals to move through space, reach impossible places, and solve clever environmental challenges. Explore stylized sci-fi levels, experiment with movement, and find your way forward.

release_games.name: Demonfall Continent
release_games.description: Explore a magic-soaked continent, battle beasts and towering bosses, learn a wide variety of skills, and shape your build with Inner Arts, attributes, and gear. Hunt for loot, cook useful food, reforge affixes, and grow stronger through every expedition in this dark mythic single-player action RPG.

release_games.name: DOOM MATES
release_games.description: An online multiplayer horror for up to 5 players. One of you is the hunter, and the rest have to work together to escape strange places. No two runs are the same, because these places always change. Create your own jumpscare and watch your friends run into it in the dark!

release_games.name: Peckout
release_games.description: Pick a side — Crow or Dove — and dive into fast, funny 8v8 egg warfare. Grab a launcher, hold the trenches, and splatter anything that moves. Six maps, six weapons, zero dignity.

release_games.name: Trials of Dash
release_games.description: Stay ahead of a deadly wall, change color with every jump, and land on the right platforms to survive.

release_games.name: Slacking Squad
release_games.description: Slacker Squad is a lightweight desktop idle game that reacts to your keyboard and mouse activity. Work hard and your squad speeds up; slack off and they do too. Mine, cook, unlock characters, and capture defeated monsters as pets while your squad keeps you company.

release_games.name: 单机斗地主
release_games.description: 《单机斗地主》是一款专为喜欢经典斗地主玩法的玩家打造的单机休闲棋牌游戏。无需联网，无需匹配其他玩家，随时打开即可开始游戏。游戏采用经典斗地主规则，玩家将与电脑AI对手进行对局，体验叫地主、抢地主、出牌与配合的完整流程。游戏提供多种难度选择，AI对手会根据难度调整出牌策略，让新手可以轻松上手，也能满足熟悉斗地主玩法的玩家挑战更高难度。游戏节奏轻快，操作简单，并支持键盘、鼠标及手柄操作。无复杂养成、无强制社交，专注于纯粹的斗地主乐趣，适合碎片时间游玩，也适合长期休闲体验。

release_games.name: WHAT LURKS BELOW
release_games.description: First-person hide-and-seek horror. Tag: a catch swaps Hunter and Runner. Hunt: a catch adds a Hunter. New maze each round. Online lobbies or bots, proximity voice.

release_games.name: Excids: Endless Siege
release_games.description: Defend your castle in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Choose your hero, survive endless enemy waves, unlock relics, skills, and upgrades, to try and finish every level.

release_games.name: Scopa Sweep
release_games.description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

release_games.name: Mythaka
release_games.description: A single-player stone-casting combat roguelike inspired by Mancala. Read the Foe’s rules, choose your pockets and combine Charms, Relics and Potions to build attacks across eight worlds inspired by mythology.

release_games.name: Nitro Nonsense
release_games.description: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8, or up to 16 players, locally or online! Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round!

release_games.name: TRAPPIST-1
release_games.description: A short sci-fi horror game. Extract energy from a red dwarf, tune signals, and power distant worlds. Do your job. Don't ask what really keeps the station running.

release_games.name: TEXAS DOMINOES
release_games.description: Play classic All Fives dominoes with a Texas twist. Score in multiples of five, control the Spinner, draw from the Boneyard, or block the game. Play against friends or solo. Relive your best rounds with game replays, stats, and badges.

release_games.name: Village of the Mirror
release_games.description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

release_games.name: Sweet Memories
release_games.description: Enjoy a colorful and perfect Halloween night. Just don't eat that candy... Please... I went to a lot of trouble to make everything better...

release_games.name: Tetromancer
release_games.description: Tetromancer is a Tetris battler where the board is your war economy. Clear lines to conjure an army, then command it in real time against wave after wave of invaders. Stack greedily and you'll field a bigger force, but crowd your board and one bad piece can bury you.

release_games.name: Mahjong Rush
release_games.description: This isn't your typical Mahjong game! Build sets and sequences to score points, land a winning hand to send your score soaring. Every run brings new shops, bosses, and challenges. Never played Mahjong before? You'll pick it up in just three minutes!

release_games.name: Horny Halloween 🎃
release_games.description: You thought going to a haunted graveyard on Hallowe’en would be a thrill-ride. Maybe see some ghosts. What you didn’t expect was her, the sexy ghoulish femme fatale who knows how to suck the very soul from your boner! Is she a curse or a gift from Heaven itself?

release_games.name: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & The Ghost Guitar
release_games.description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

release_games.name: Topdeck Duel
release_games.description: An incremental card roguelike where every victory expands your deck! Position cards for powerful buffs, claim enemy cards, and merge them to increase their rarity. Accumulate gold for permanent meta-upgrades between runs and master the Topdeck Duel!

release_games.name: Laser Lode
release_games.description: Slice through endless ore veins with a high‑energy laser, listen to the clear ring of rare minerals hitting the ground, and witness your wealth skyrocket from single digits to astronomical numbers. 10 minerals, 80 achievements – an incremental feast reserved solely for the laser.

release_games.name: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
release_games.description: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

release_games.name: 60病　The 60-Second Syndrome
release_games.description: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

release_games.name: Chain of Command
release_games.description: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

release_games.name: Endless Tower
release_games.description: Climb an endless tower, keep your momentum, and time each jump to reach the next platform. No enemies — just your reflexes and your own record. The tower regenerates every run, so every climb is a chance to beat your best.

release_games.name: Adultery Marriage Punisher
release_games.description: "Adultery Marriage Punisher" Curing marriage pests! Investigate. Infiltrate. Snap. Spy. Steal. Outwit. What is your spouse doing behind your back? Your evidence, the deadliest sanction. Now, become the shadow of justice, and unveil every betrayal and infidelity!

release_games.name: Flipping Phantom
release_games.description: A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

release_games.name: Sign: Broken Kether
release_games.description: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Lyra, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

release_games.name: The Gassal
release_games.description: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?

release_games.name: Spin To Win
release_games.description: Flick, brake and reverse your way from one tiny fidget spinner to a bustling pixel arcade. Restore machines, build gadget combinations, master mouse driven minigames and spend earned Tickets on chance games and cosmetics.

release_games.name: TRACE IT
release_games.description: A cozy paper-style train-track logic puzzle. Use the row and column numbers to lay one railway from entrance to exit; every level has exactly one solution. 500 levels plus Endless, Relax and Daily modes. Finish the line and watch the little train roll out.

release_games.name: Bubble Hunters
release_games.description: Pop bubbles, dodge danger and master 100 handcrafted levels in this colorful 2D arcade platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op, then chase high scores in Survival and Marathon modes.

release_games.name: PrankzPlz!
release_games.description: Every great prank starts with a simple idea. Matt’s usually ends in complete chaos.

release_games.name: Reel to the Stars
release_games.description: Drag your bobber and reel in a whole screen of fish! Upgrade your rod, grow a huge skill tree, and fish your way from a quiet pond through the Arctic, the deep sea and the Dragon Palace all the way to outer space. A cozy fishing incremental with 278 fish species and your own aquarium.

release_games.name: Quota: Hit Your Number
release_games.description: The sales satire as an incremental career game: you start on the phone yourself, nailing call timing and chasing meetings. The higher you climb, the more your team works for you, until you take the company public. Ripen deals, fuse your team, conquer the map as VP.

release_games.name: N in One 中国骨牌合集：牌九、天九、接龙、顶牛
release_games.description: Pull up a chair! Discover 16 domino games, from Pai Gow and traditional Tien Gow to connecting, collecting and matching tiles. Learn with illustrated practice, face two BOT difficulties, and unlock cozy table styles with play-earned points. A single-player collection with local saves.

release_games.name: Last House Standing
release_games.description: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

release_games.name: SLUP
release_games.description: Collect Gems, keep your combo alive, and outrun your own past. Every path you take returns as a moving Past, turning your previous choices into deadly obstacles in this strategic arcade score-attack game.

release_games.name: Halmweit
release_games.description: A cozy building game to play alone or with friends. You share one village, one storehouse and everyone who lives there. Chop trees, plant fields, lay a railway and get your village through the winter. There's no fighting, and you can't lose.

release_games.name: Give Us Back Gravity
release_games.description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

release_games.name: Lumbrix
release_games.description: Lumbrix is a survivors-like shooter where every segment of your growing worm is both a weapon and a life. Aim your head cannon, shield yourself with your body, evolve your weapons and survive ten minutes to face the boss.

release_games.name: SpellWeave
release_games.description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

release_games.name: DeepCore Breach
release_games.description: Thousands of rift creatures. One base. Aim every turret's line of fire, then take the main cannon into your own hands. Take down five bosses across 15 maps, grow stronger between runs, and climb the global leaderboard in Endless. Build and share your own maps on the Workshop.

release_games.name: Gross Survivors
release_games.description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

release_games.name: Project Neko
release_games.description: Pilot a cat-shaped ship through a neon rhythm tunnel. Hit, hold and trace notes to the beat, chase high scores, and take a loud, unruly cat band from rehearsal room to stage. Unlock partners and songs across four difficulties in this music-driven arcade adventure.

release_games.name: Quiz Bang!
release_games.description: 《Quiz Bang! 》is a first-person party shooter for 2–6 players. On this not-so-safe TV show, answer questions or beat minigames to earn ammo. Take on another challenge, or turn around and shoot your friends? A friendly reminder: watch your back while answering.

release_games.name: KING 4 A DAY
release_games.description: KING 4 A DAY is a small, straightforward roguelike strategy game inspired by chess. Lead four humble pawns across procedurally generated levels, adapt to ever-changing laws, and brave a kingdom of black-and-white roads to rescue the kidnapped White King.

release_games.name: KickOff
release_games.description: A kid from the outskirts wants to go pro. When his mother falls ill, the dream becomes a bill: $50,000 in treatment, rent that climbs on its own, and a clock that never stops. Work, train, take penalties — and choose where to be on the day it all lands at once.

release_games.name: AVXRPG
release_games.description: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from a home town: fight, gather, complete stage quests, and forge your way forward.

release_games.name: Shear line
release_games.description: A physics-based lockpicking simulator with no dice rolls or hidden checks. Learn how cylinder, combination, and disc-detainer locks work, then put your lockpicking skills to the test.

release_games.name: Dead Pulse
release_games.description: Dead Pulse is an atmospheric, adrenaline-fueled zombie survival FPS set in a red-tinted post-apocalyptic wasteland. Face endless waves of the undead, unlock powerful weapons and roguelite skills, and fight to survive the crimson night in a dark, gritty world.

release_games.name: Fire Bug
release_games.description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

release_games.name: +PROTECTUS-
release_games.description: 🧲 A minimalist first‑person puzzle game where you have to escape from a ruined lunar complex using an experimental magnetic cannon and uncover the secrets of the ECHO project together with the drone Kruitni.

release_games.name: Homeless Kiosk Simulator
release_games.description: You work the night shift inside a small aid booth. People arrive at your window asking for help. Food. Water. Medicine. Sometimes… things that don’t belong in a donation box. Every box you prepare makes the night worse.

release_games.name: Behind the Corner
release_games.description: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

release_games.name: My Stylish Life
release_games.description: It's 2008, and you just sat down at the family computer. Run your own boutique, build your dream wardrobe, make new friends, fall in love, and explore a colorful world where every day is yours to style. Welcome to My Stylish Life.

release_games.name: Ball Bugz
release_games.description: Ball Bugs is an incremental defense game where you start with a single persistent ball and build up an arsenal of ball firing turrets, artillery and special ball types. Bounce, splat, upgrade and come back stronger until the bugs stop getting through.

release_games.name: AL-Mafia
release_games.description: AL-Mafia is an online social deduction game where players lie, investigate, save, silence, and vote each other out. Move through the map at night, use voice and text chat to deceive or defend yourself, and survive across maps with unique elimination systems.

release_games.name: Nile Express
release_games.description: Build the first railway network in Africa. Create profitable routes in Egypt, from Alexandria to Aswan. Deliver passengers and goods to the right destinations. Take care of your railway network and deal with accidents.

release_games.name: Iron Online
release_games.description: Iron Online is a new indie PvP MMO in Early Access! Designed around player vs player world events. Join our Discord! The invitation link is available on the game's login page. Still has lots of bugs! I'm working through them, please be kind for now.

release_games.name: Foodland Puzzle
release_games.description: Foodland puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with food themed images

release_games.name: Clapitalism
release_games.description: Turn a single clap into a worldwide ovation. Clapitalism is an incremental game about growing an audience, engineering louder applause, and filling bigger venues. Take an Encore to restart with permanent Fame, then build an even stronger show.

release_games.name: Lily or Horse
release_games.description: The easiest game in the world. Flip a coin and call it: lily or horse? Call it right 10 times in a row to win. Miss, and the coins you bet are thrown away. With a little luck, it only takes 10 flips.

release_games.name: Idle Gas Station Tycoon
release_games.description: Turn a tiny roadside pump into a thriving highway service empire. Serve cars, grow your station, hire staff, add a shop, car wash, garage, truck stop and EV chargers, then expand to new locations. A relaxing low-poly idle tycoon, no ads, fully offline.

release_games.name: Dawn Archive
release_games.description: Choose rooms. Rotate them. Connect your path. Shape a mysterious mansion in this exploration and puzzle adventure. With limited steps and keys, solve puzzles and follow clues in forgotten records to reach the archive deep within.

release_games.name: Slaskescape 2
release_games.description: 40 interconnected skills fuel your next upgrade in this single-player 3D idle RPG. Gather materials, craft better gear and automate your supplies with hired workers, summons and inventions. Choose your next unlock, then let your character get to work.

release_games.name: Pocket Sports
release_games.description: Grab a friend and split one handheld down the middle. Air hockey, bowling, sumo and Turf Wars for two: each player holds one side, or play online with a Steam friend.

release_games.name: Pikabuu: Home
release_games.description: Rian and Febi thought they found their dream home at a cheap price, unaware of its dark history. Experience their daily life from dual perspectives in this psychological horror game. Face relentless terror, make critical choices, and uncover the truth: are they truly the only ones inside?

release_games.name: 猫咪之家 CatHome
release_games.description: Run your stray cat shelter using a classic slot machine game format.

release_games.name: FUTA GIRLS
release_games.description: FUTA GIRLS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

release_games.name: Wild Draw
release_games.description: Play cards. Screw over your friends. Then shoot it out. WILD DRAW is a first-person party game for 3–6 players where every round starts at the saloon table and ends in chaos.

release_games.name: V-Buddy UltraDeluxe
release_games.description: VBuddy is back, written from the ground up to be more featureful and better than ever! Feed sweets and tiny people to a cast of colourful characters and unlock new toys, skins and backgrounds for your V-Buddy UltraDeluxe!

release_games.name: Echo in the Lightless Deep
release_games.description: Echo in the Lightless Deep is a deep-sea survivor roguelite. Symbionts fight for you; you steer, dodge and build. The brighter your core, the farther you see and strike, and the more the deep sends at you. Five giants guard the way down. At the bottom, choose: return to the light, or stay dark.

release_games.name: 赛博拼豆
release_games.description: A free, offline bead-crafting game with 40 studio-original patterns, including 10 for Halloween, plus 6 starters. Turn photos into bead guides with background removal, then place beads and iron your work. No ads or in-app purchases. Simplified Chinese interface.

release_games.name: Shatterwing
release_games.description: Turn enemy fire into your greatest weapon. SHATTERWING is a pixel-art bullet hell shooter where you dash to create mirrors, reflect deadly volleys, and build your ship across five stages. Master six ships or switch colors and absorb bullets in Polarity mode.

release_games.name: SHAME
release_games.description: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

release_games.name: Catch The Ducks
release_games.description: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.

release_games.name: ChessGuardians
release_games.description: Play on boards that challenge the imagination — from a classic office to holographic, post-apocalyptic and more. Face different engines, variants, import your games, and play against millions of players. The chess you know. The excitement you never imagined.

release_games.name: Puzzle Penguins
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Lakes
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Puzzle Musical Instruments
release_games.description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

release_games.name: Money Burner
release_games.description: Slice banknotes, smash gold and torch piles of cash in this cartoon first-person incremental game. Earn rewards, upgrade your weapons and break into new rooms. Start with scissors and work your way up to a flamethrower and a massive laser cannon.

release_games.name: GomokuSoccer
release_games.description: Place or Flick? In Gomoku Soccer, you can place your stones just to build a line of five, or flick them off the board and watch your opponent crashing out. Test your strategy and your aim!

release_games.name: DRIFTIT
release_games.description: Top-down drift racing with deep arcade physics. Throw one car sideways through 20 hand-built tracks in five low-poly worlds, chain slides for points, chase your own ghost and set the fastest three-lap time on Steam leaderboards checked against every run's replay.

release_games.name: 模拟穿越-三国
release_games.description: 穿越到群雄并起的汉末，你不是开局便号令天下的主公，而是从小卒、文吏或斥候起步的无名之人。结识会记住承诺、恩情与背叛的历史人物，完成上官任务，献上计策，积累军功与治绩，在复杂的人脉和官场中争取升迁。你可以招募亲随、经营私人部曲、组建攻城军团、治理城池、发展势力科技，也能求亲成婚、经营家庭，或在时机成熟时举旗自立。每推进一个月，战争、调任、疾病、背叛和天下大势都会继续演变；你的选择不仅决定自己的仕途，也可能让熟悉的三国历史走向另一条道路。

release_games.name: Cellwright - A FreeCell Roguelike
release_games.description: This is FreeCell, re-imagined as a roguelike. Chain cards to the foundations to build Mult, collect relics that multiply each other, and beat every deal's quota. Win the eight-ante run, then push into true Endless. Renown, feats and eight Grades carry over between runs.

release_games.name: Coffee Keeper
release_games.description: Sort 4,179 scattered bags, tins, bottles, brewing gear, pastries and more throughout a two-storey coffee house. Match every piece to its proper place, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

release_games.name: QuestAway
