release_games.description: Radical Zomboarding is a roguelike snowboarding game that's all about shredding powder and shooting zombies. Do tricks, buy perks, and soak the slopes with blood!

release_games.name: Mimic Alert
release_games.description: A co-op horror game where anything can be a mimic. Memorize the building by day, hunt by night with a friend — or play PvP: one Mimic Queen against up to four humans.

release_games.name: Abandoned Hearts
release_games.description: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

release_games.name: ALYSSA
release_games.description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.

release_games.name: Elevator Button Simulator
release_games.description: Step into an elevator, press the buttons, and travel between floors. A simulator built around a small part of everyday life. Enjoy watching the elevator respond to each press.

release_games.name: Chained Pirates Together
release_games.description: A cursed skull has chained your crew together, and only a lightning strike at the summit can break it. Climb 1000 meters in this physics-based co-op climbing game for 1–4 pirates, where one bad jump drags everyone down with you.

release_games.name: MAZZIOSI
release_games.description: MAZZIOSI is a single-player 3v3 card battler in a crooked city. Choose three of 63 heroes, combine their abilities and outsmart eccentric bosses. Follow a comic-book campaign or take on roguelite runs with branching routes and powerful boosts.

release_games.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
release_games.description: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid-boss Herald at the end of the Doom Clock. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

release_games.name: Fruitpocalypse
release_games.description: The veggies have risen. Only the fruits stand in their way. Survive 20 waves of evil vegetables, twisted bosses and cursed nights in this cartoon arena roguelite.

release_games.name: Grind Grid
release_games.description: A pixel-art incremental clicker-idler where 96 monsters and 32 idle blocks each level up independently. Hover your mouse — damage fires on its own. Prestige, evolutions, perks, tiers, and hundreds of upgrades. How far can you push the numbers?

release_games.name: Song Bao's Adventure
release_games.description: Adapted from real lives. Song Bao leaves Shengdu on a scholarship to Lion City, where he learns the language, the rules, and the overtime — until lightning turns him into a chicken. A fully-voiced ink-wash interactive film: 40 scenes, 4 endings, told with a smile.

release_games.name: A Hoard in Order
release_games.description: After a storm made a mess on The Salty Scallop, it is up to you, the Quartermaster, to put everything back in its place in this cozy sorting game.

release_games.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
release_games.description: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

release_games.name: Chaos Chess Definitive Edition
release_games.description: Chess, reimagined! Draft powerful Champions with unique abilities, outsmart your opponent, and adapt to board-altering Chaos events. Master classic chess, dominate online PvP, or conquer the epic single-player campaign. All 34 launch Champions and 7 scenarios are included in one purchase.

release_games.name: STOREBOT: Tidy Up PC Parts
release_games.description: Organize thousands of PC parts, complete shelves, unlock powerful upgrades, and work together with friends to tidy up a chaotic computer store. Carry, throw, and sort boxes across two unique maps while building your perfect store.

release_games.name: Simply A Button
release_games.description: 48 rooms. 48 challenges. No pressure. A first-person, puzzle, platformer where every room is something different and there's nothing to prove. Solve the puzzles at your leisure. If need be there is a hint and answer sign for you in every room. No one will know. But you will know. You will know.

release_games.name: Sidetrack — Tiny Trains for Your Desktop
release_games.description: A cozy idle railway game that lives along the edge of your desktop while you work. Buy engines and wagons, deliver cargo, fill contracts and blow the whistle for coins as five districts grow along one long line: vans stop at shop doors, windows light up at dusk and boats drift down the river.

release_games.name: PALJA Survivors
release_games.description: A survival roguelike where your birth date determines your Saju character. Dodge swarming foes, choose upgrades and items, and face five years of yearly battles and Guardians shaped by your fortune. Even with the same Saju, your choices lead to a different journey.

release_games.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
release_games.description: Battles are fully automatic. Scoop up ★-rated loot, upgrade it, and push deeper. Beat your first boss within minutes and find ★2 and ★3 gear right away. 106 dungeons, Lv 999, 72 characters, and 100 Steam achievements — an idle hack-and-slash RPG that plays itself while you watch.

release_games.name: TSUKIMI PLANET -CLASSIC REMASTER-
release_games.description: A mysterious girl named Tsukimi appears beside a terminally ill young man, claiming to be an alien from the Moon. She offers to grant his final wish. His answer is simple: “I want to talk with you again tomorrow.” A short visual novel reborn as a CLASSIC REMASTER.

release_games.name: Gems & Palace
release_games.description: Dig through layered mines, uncover 60 unique gems, master an arsenal of mining tools, and complete your collection. Display every discovery in the Gem Museum and use your treasures to illuminate the Myriad Crystal Palace.

release_games.name: Ashnar's Lair
release_games.description: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

release_games.name: Chat is Cooked
release_games.description: Turn your Twitch chat into part of the show. Grab and throw chatters, drop them into the pot, and let messages, channel points, Bits, and subscriptions trigger chaotic effects in this customizable streamer overlay game.

release_games.name: Little Pot, Big Seasons
release_games.description: A tiny potted plant in a soft, healing animated style, living in the corner of your desktop. Transparent, always-on-top, truly zero UI. Water it, feed it, weed it, and walk with it from sprout through all four seasons. Rain, snow and light drift by; little chalkboards tell you what it needs.

release_games.name: Solo Shift! Karaoke
release_games.description: Front desk, food and drinks, cleaning—you've got to manage it all! Take on task after task all by yourself!

release_games.name: Trivia Mania
release_games.description: Welcome to Trivia Mania! Test your knowledge about the most common trivia questions, and improve your own performance. Trivia Mania has over 4,700 questions across eight genres. Game modes such as the Gauntlet, Ladder, Survival and Custom allow you to play in different fun and interactive ways.

release_games.name: Bullet Breakfast
release_games.description: Bullet Breakfast is a fast-paced 3D third-person arena shooter. Choose from five unique heroes, master their weapons and abilities, collect powerful upgrades, survive endless waves of undead, and defeat the Demon King before sunrise!

release_games.name: Memory Moth
release_games.description: Memory Moth blends roguelike, tower defense, farming, and resource management. Grow crops, build defenses, team up with animal companions, fight waves of pests, create unique builds, and recover fading memories.

release_games.name: Flamebound Tactics
release_games.description: Flamebound Tactics is a pixel-art strategy puzzle. Place units on suitable terrain, combine their unique coverage patterns, and light every brazier without exceeding the budget. Solve 30 handcrafted stages across islands of varied shapes and terrain.

release_games.name: Rescuing My Wife
release_games.description: Your wife, Amanda, has been kidnapped by a family of demonic creatures. Explore the mansion, solve puzzles, defeat the demonic family members, and find Amanda.

release_games.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
release_games.description: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

release_games.name: NOVA
release_games.description: Conquer the galaxy one world at a time. Nova is a fast, minimalist real-time strategy game of fleets, factions and gravity. Send your forces between planets, portals and stations, outmaneuver seven rival AI factions, and survive black holes and asteroid belts across 12 chapters.

release_games.name: Polandball: The Sixth Day - Destroy
release_games.description: Endless waves of infected are closing in! A single-player, top-down endless survival shooter starring countryballs. Survive through your own choices and builds, create a character of your own, and fight through a living day-night cycle as the world gradually falls apart.

release_games.name: The 31st Student
release_games.description: Thirty names. Thirty-one desks. Explore a deserted Japanese high school, uncover conflicting records, and confront the memories you helped erase. A first-person psychological horror mystery with three endings. Play on a monitor or in VR.

release_games.name: Skyts
release_games.description: Two hundred and sixteen km/h and nothing to hold on to. Beat your own ghost, take the same line as five other runners, or fight them for a lit bomb that slows down whoever carries it. Six tracks, a daily challenge, a map editor, skins to earn.

release_games.name: Second Source
release_games.description: Every report on your desk is intelligence or bait. Four artifacts — agency, timestamp, position, text — and a planted one contradicts itself in exactly one. Call it before the clock does, hold the line as DEFCON drops, and when they breach the building, run the extraction on foot.

release_games.name: Hentai Femboy Housekeeper
release_games.description: Hentai Femboy Housekeeper brings cozy home vibes, charming femboys, and playful surprises. Complete relaxing puzzles, reveal exclusive artwork, and make every room feel special.

release_games.name: Axiom of Stars
release_games.description: Resurrect a fallen sky, one constellation at a time. Axiom of Stars is a calm, luminous logic puzzle game: 2048 puzzles across multiple constellations, each a new way to think, and new mechanics to figure out.

release_games.name: THERMAL RUNAWAY
release_games.description: A top-down roguelite inside one sealed chamber. Ten levels, one hundred waves, and upgrades that compound into something the facility was not built to contain. The run ends when you break — or when the reaction does.

release_games.name: AFTER CLOSING - 闭店之后
release_games.description: After closing, only two people are left in the office. She's your manager, six years older, and she never takes off that silver watch. She says this doesn't count - she's said it four times. A short adult visual novel about order coming apart: four stat-driven endings, seven H scenes.

release_games.name: Dub House
release_games.description: One to eight players, a party game where you only use your voice, Take a character each, record your lines, then watch it back with your takes where the actors used to be. Four modes: Dub, Telephone, Rap Booth. Plus a clip editor

release_games.name: Idle Plinko
release_games.description: Build the ultimate Plinko machine in this incremental idle game. Level up to discover unique boards, buy powerful upgrades, unlock special balls, gamble to transform your pegs, and prestige for permanent perks. Compete with players worldwide and climb the leaderboards.

release_games.name: Play and Learn: German
release_games.description: First we get you speaking, then we make you better. A story RPG where the microphone is the controller: a full A1 to B2 German course, 15 role-play rooms, 6,100 spoken sentences, every meaning in your own language. Fully offline, one-time purchase.

release_games.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1: Lost Friend
release_games.description: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

release_games.name: Biblioclash Digital
release_games.description: Biblioclash Digital is the official digital version of Biblioclash for Windows and macOS. In this deck-building game players bring their own custom set of cards to play and try to defeat their opponent in a magical duel.

release_games.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
release_games.description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

release_games.name: Orbital Madness
release_games.description: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

release_games.name: Please Advise
release_games.description: You've been sent to a private clinic to audit the books. You're really here to find out who killed your uncle. You cannot speak, so you answer by gesture or on a tablet. Balance the clinic's money, patient trust, staff loyalty, and your own conscience.

release_games.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
release_games.description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

release_games.name: DaoNoKa hide
release_games.description: Don't fear to speak e lusive words. The only certainty is that all things present shall fade away in time. Friends from overseas have recommended consulting relevant reference books during your playthrough of the work.

release_games.name: Overlap
release_games.description: Fast-paced 2D wave shooter built around the parry. Two weapons, a coin shop, nine planets of story, and a style meter that punishes the timid. Reach SSS rank, clear the campaign, or die trying.

release_games.name: SAKIMORI
release_games.description: Explore cursed locations, locate cursed objects, and purify them. Alongside the guardian Saku Tsukino, confront the curse within an anomalous space, purify the cursed objects, and survive. A first-person horror Roguelite set in abandoned Japanese locations.

release_games.name: Battle Nap
release_games.description: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

release_games.name: Wartide
release_games.description: A military idle defense that runs as a desktop widget or full screen. Deploy infantry, tanks and gunships against waves from every side, evolve eight vehicle lines from WWII to modern armor and call in air strikes. Pin it beside your work, or go full screen and take command.

release_games.name: TitleIt!
release_games.description: Turn a photo into the funniest caption. Write, vote and compete in quick online rounds with friends on Steam, Android and the web. Play for free, join with a room code and collect your winning moments. Optional purchases available.

release_games.name: Risk it Little Biscuit
release_games.description: Risk it, little biscuit! Crunch through endless hordes of sugar-crazed sweets in this bite-sized bullet-heaven roguelite. Pick a hero from the pantry, stack absurd snack weapons, evolve them into pure kitchen chaos and topple crowned bosses, one crumbly run at a time.

release_games.name: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color
release_games.description: 🐱 Discover 200 hidden cats across 2 artistic hand-drawn scenes 🖌️. Relax with color-by-numbers 🎨 and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op 👯‍♂️, while Meow FM 🎶 sets the perfect creative mood.

release_games.name: Lost Jelly
release_games.description: A cute puzzle arcade game where your robot can't stop moving! Guide Nimble across colorful farm levels, collect every runaway Jelly, and reach the exit. With broken brakes and a growing trail of boxes behind him, every move matters!

release_games.name: Tow Game
release_games.description: Tow Game is a physics-based action game where you control a car being towed by a tow truck. Swing around the environment using the tow cable and earn points by causing chaos and destruction.

release_games.name: Terror In The Shadowrealms
release_games.description: Explore unsettling environments, search for anomalies, and survive unexpected encounters in this short indie horror game.

release_games.name: Sakura Hime 7
release_games.description: In a paradise of blooming cherry blossoms, catgirls, witches, and elves gather around you. Share sweet everyday moments with them and build a lavish harem all your own.

release_games.name: King of Jewelry
release_games.description: Run a vintage jewelry business: hunt for bargains, haggle, appraise and sell to the right customer. Build your collection from thousands of pieces, balance stock against the bills, and solve 500 jewelry puzzles to earn new treasures.

release_games.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced [Episode 1]
release_games.description: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

release_games.name: Atrion Project
release_games.description: A hybrid with no memories. A planet out to kill you. A demanding sci-fi action game with fast-paced combat and die & retry mechanics. Fight. Die. Learn. Retry. Your body is a weapon. Your past, a mystery.

release_games.name: Moadra
release_games.description: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

release_games.name: Lighthouse of Madness
release_games.description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you on this island. Explore the island, solve challenging puzzles, and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity.

release_games.name: Monsters, Inn Order!
release_games.description: Check in for cute monsters and deliciously tangled logic puzzles. Arrange a line of peculiar guests, connect their clues, and chase that glorious “aha!” across 100+ puzzles. Make unlikely friends, uncover a little mystery, and find a place for everyone.

release_games.name: Robot Fisher
release_games.description: Third person fishing simulation game, where player controls lonely robot who are just fishing

release_games.name: BOOMSWEEPER
release_games.description: An incremental twist on classic Minesweeper. Sweep, earn, upgrade, hire a crew, dig up Finds and go deeper into boards inside boards. One wrong click... BOOM.

release_games.name: Oval Office Tidy Up
release_games.description: Some people will finish it in one sitting. Some will start by recognizing a few flags and leave knowing exactly where Benin is. Read the flag on each folder, figure out where that country is and file it on the right continent shelf. Tidy up fast and beat your best time.

release_games.name: Farkle: Tavern Dice
release_games.description: Farkle: Tavern Dice brings the classic push-your-luck dice game to a cozy medieval tavern. Roll for points, decide when to bank your score, and risk another throw for a bigger payoff—or lose the round.

release_games.name: My Own Roguelike: RPG
release_games.description: An auto-attack roguelite RPG. Pick level-up cards every run, farm gear with random options and grow a 331-node passive tree to craft a build that is all your own — across 9 worlds, Hell difficulty and an endless boss tower.

release_games.name: Taskbar Cat
release_games.description: A little company for your Windows desktop. Adopt cats with unique coats, eyes and personalities. Watch them wander, nap and play along your taskbar, then take a break to pet them, share treats and care for your growing cat family.

release_games.name: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
release_games.description: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king’s ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

release_games.name: O'BLOCK
release_games.description: You start with $300 and a shoebox. You end up selling sneakers to billionaires, if you can read who's lying. Every buyer hides their number and some lie about it. Free to play: name your price, win the deal, climb from the block to a billion.

release_games.name: Fzzy Bzzy's The Beautiful Ones
release_games.description: A straight forward action rpg where you play as Shell, a mouse destined to lead sinking mice out of the dark! Based around the Universe 25 experiment, a dying society of rats and mice fight to survive in a post-apocalyptic world!

release_games.name: Sudoku Unlimited
release_games.description: Settle into a cozy garden of Sudoku. Solve classic grids and clever variants, learn with step-by-step hints, and unlock new scenery as you play. Share a board in online co-op or keep a small puzzle beside your other apps.

release_games.name: TPS Tickman: Castle Defense
release_games.description: Hold the canyon wall against 30 waves of stickmen in a laid-back third-person shooter. Arm your castle with auto turrets, missiles, drones and cavalry, hijack enemy tanks, fly a gunship, and bring down six giant bosses. No grind, no difficulty levels — just shoot.

release_games.name: Farthest
release_games.description: Start with nothing. Get as far as you can. Explore an endless, procedurally generated maze, crack open chests, unlock portals, and when the clock runs out, outrun the Void. How far will you get?

release_games.name: STAR CIPHER
release_games.description: Turn English vocabulary practice into a sci-fi typing battle. Type answers to stop falling enemies, build combos, and tackle faster waves. Explore 100 chapters with comic dialogues, pronunciation audio, and a practice mode you can play at your own pace.

release_games.name: ROTORORA Drone Racing
release_games.description: Race through five colorful worlds in 8-drone battles. Fly up and down, choose boost detours, and compete with missiles, rapid fire and shields. Play solo with CPU rivals or join online rooms, with arcade controls and optional quad physics.

release_games.name: Kaiju Climber
release_games.description: Kaiju Climber is a surreal action-platformer where the goal is simple; Get to the next checkpoint! (Try not to die) Guide your chicken through dozens of intense levels - where falls, hazards and Kaiju wish to see you cooked. Brought to you by the one-man indie project: Capesize Entertainment.

release_games.name: Rocket's Way
release_games.description: Rocket's Way is a simple indie arcade game about flying a little rocket through space. Inspired by games like Flappy Bird, control your rocket, avoid asteroids and obstacles, and find your way through three handcrafted levels.

release_games.name: Slime Playgrounds
release_games.description: You can't complete the game alone! Team up with your friends, solve tricky puzzles, and overcome chaotic obstacles in this cute and hilarious co-op adventure. Play together locally or remotely with Steam Remote Play Together.

release_games.name: Arcade with Friends
release_games.description: A neon arcade for your next game night. Play minigolf, steal flags, draw clues and test your reflexes with 2–8 players. Explore ten arcade cabinets, switch between game modes and compete in tournaments online or over LAN. Who takes the podium tonight?

release_games.name: Apples Everywhere! Let's Tidy Up
release_games.description: The orchard is overflowing, and there are Apples Everywhere! Clean up the grounds in this cozy Tidy-Up-lite, where there are only two things to sort: good apples and wormy ones. Earn coins, buy upgrades, unlock animal helpers and uncover the orchard's secrets. Let's tidy up!

release_games.name: Bird Empire
release_games.description: Build a legendary bird farm in a cozy idle game. Collect six bird species, sell eggs, fulfill customer orders, develop new facilities, earn offline income, and begin new cycles to unlock permanent bonuses for your growing empire.

release_games.name: Uncanny Train
release_games.description: A horror puzzle walking simulator. Trapped aboard a strange train, your goal is to reach Carriage -1. Along the way, you will encounter eerie anomalies and solve environmental puzzles. Headphones are recommended for full immersion.

release_games.name: JIGOKU YUGI: Only The Last Gambler Standing Returns to Life
release_games.description: You died slipping on your own winning lottery ticket. Now you're one of 100 corpses in Hell's Ninth Gambling Den: 32 sadistic games, each with a hidden trap, a cheating demon croupier and your funeral streaming live. Only the last gambler standing returns to life.

release_games.name: Clean your Garden
release_games.description: Clean Your Garden is an incremental: you click the screen, you kill bugs, you earn amber. Amber unlocks weapons, tree branches and allies, and the next run pays far better. Twelve weapons, six bosses and a whole desert to open up.

release_games.name: Frag Party
release_games.description: A party board game for 2 to 8 players. Race around a living 3D board, buy stars and fire rockets at whoever is winning — then the board stops and drops everyone into one of 50 challenges. Axes, glass bridges, demolition derbies, bowling. Bring friends. Lose them.

release_games.name: PunchMonkey
release_games.description: Keep a little monkey and a banana tree on the corner of your desktop. Every key you type makes the monkey punch the tree and knock down ripe bananas. Spend them to decorate your mouse cursor. Punch together with your Steam friends, too.

release_games.name: Battle Gaze
release_games.description: Battle Gaze is a fast-paced 2D retro action-adventure hack-and-slash. Master 5 unique weapons—sword, bow, deadly claws, light sword, and hay fork—unleash fluid combos, and defeat ruthless bosses across dangerous lands to reclaim your ancestral heritage!

release_games.name: Mine Heroes
release_games.description: Mine Heroes = Minesweeper + Tetris + dice RPG. Clear 80% of the board to find the exit, roll dice to trigger your class skill, and fight monsters on a minesweeper grid. 5 classes plus a hidden one, 80 levels - a 2D pixel roguelite that runs on anything.

release_games.name: Baccarata
release_games.description: A roguelike deckbuilding game built on baccarat, where the card you throw away goes to your opponent. Choose what to give up each hand, size your bets to chase a streak multiplier, and spend single-use cards to rescue a bad hand across twelve tables that each break the rules differently.

release_games.name: Messa Anomaly
release_games.description: Messa Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting museum. Observe each corridor, spot unsettling changes, and choose the correct path. One mistake can send you deeper into a night shift that refuses to end.

release_games.name: Pawnimals
release_games.description: Lead ten animal armies in 3D chess. Challenge the computer across five difficulties or play a friend locally. Learn with Danger Sense and 100 guided lessons, solve 100 mate-in-two puzzles, and conquer the nine-battle Gauntlet.

release_games.name: Bio Inc. Classic
release_games.description: Relive the original Bio Inc. experience, rebuilt from the ground up for PC to celebrate its 15th anniversary. Develop deadly diseases, cripple your victim’s body, and determine their ultimate fate in this biomedical strategy simulator.

release_games.name: The Inkspire
release_games.description: The Inkspire is a hand-drawn deck-building roguelike. Choose from five unique characters, build powerful card synergies, collect relics, and climb an ever-changing tower filled with battles, shops, and mysterious events.

release_games.name: DON'T SWITCH
release_games.description: Co-op horror for 2-3 friends (or solo). Ransack a haunted mansion for cursed tapes, wake the spectres and blast them back to hell with a holy cross. Keep your energy up: the thing in the walls can possess you, and then YOU are the one hunting your friends.

release_games.name: Yakiniku!!!
release_games.description: Fire up the grill in this first-person yakiniku restaurant sim. Run it solo or with your friends in Career Mode, or compete directly against them as rival restaurants across the street in Rival Mode. Prep, serve, grill, restock, and build your restaurant into the pride of the shopping street!

release_games.name: MECCHA LIAR
release_games.description: 2 to 4 participants gathered in pursuit of a massive cash prize. The moment they open their eyes, they are trapped in unfamiliar darkness and each other's lies. In a place where no one can be trusted, only one can survive.

release_games.name: We Are Good Delivery
release_games.description: A first-person action score-attack game about dealing with one spaceship disaster after another. Put out fires, patch hull breaches, handle asteroids and aliens, and survive your 10-minute shift. Protect your cargo and ship as you chase a higher score in this chaotic space delivery game.

release_games.name: Handle with Care!
release_games.description: A co-op delivery game where you play as tiny postal workers in a town that’s trying to kill you. Deliver everything from coffins to ticking bombs, escape rabid dogs and berserk drivers, and stay in business for six days to earn your pint on Sunday.

release_games.name: Fuse Beads Simulator
release_games.description: A simple and tense fuse bead challenge game.

release_games.name: Folk-Tography
release_games.description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

release_games.name: SIX
release_games.description: Roll the die. Every six multiplies your pot, anything else and it's gone.

release_games.name: BioSphere: Genesis
release_games.description: A science clicker inspired by real biochemistry. Grow a living planet from elementary particles: catch atoms, fuse them into molecules, synthesize amino acids, proteins and cells — turn raw matter into life through simple clicks. No prestige points, only natural units.

release_games.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
release_games.description: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!

release_games.name: Grease Trap '99
release_games.description: Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

release_games.name: Dreams Of A Visionary
release_games.description: Dreams Of A Visionary is a first-person exploration adventure set in a mysterious Victorian mansion. Explore richly detailed rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the hidden secrets of this surreal dream.

release_games.name: ARCS
release_games.description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

release_games.name: Dearbnb
release_games.description: Buy, Decorate, Rent, Relax. Start with a tiny apartment, decorate cozy spaces, manage rentals and businesses, and rise from a poor neighborhood to the city’s most prestigious zones. A calming yet deep management experience where every room tells a story.

release_games.name: All Eyes on Me
release_games.description: A solo developed, hand-modeled, creepy cozy game. You're a new hire at the BlinkTwice delivery services. Purchase (or steal) items and deliver them to your customers. Or find new ways to make profit like fishing, mining, recycling bottles, garbage picking, and more!

release_games.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection
release_games.description: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.

release_games.name: ミズイロ・コンバージ
release_games.description: 樹形図を用いた生物分類推察、生物学者の青年フィルゼとの交流。二つの要素が物語を生み出す、異色の『生物分類恋愛ADV』！

release_games.name: Bunny Hopper
release_games.description: Bunny Hopper is a fast-paced 3D platformer where every move counts! Master wall-running, dashes, and jumps, dodge deadly traps, and shoot targets without slowing down. Control a combat robot, conquer challenging courses, and put your reflexes to the test!

release_games.name: Inky's Sleep
release_games.description: Step into Inky’s sleep — a haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.

release_games.name: GORA
release_games.description: Your harvest has a health bar. Defend it as a gun-toting pumpkin in this colorful action roguelite. Dodge monster waves, upgrade your weapons and turn defeated foes into fertilizer. Survive the night, save your crops and unlock your next guardian.

release_games.name: Cutout Village
release_games.description: Build your own little paper village in this relaxing city-builder focused on building and crafting. Cut, fold and glue to help it grow, discover its story and join its inhabitants as they slowly bring life back to its streets.

release_games.name: Rocket Shift
release_games.description: Master the first 2-button rocket physics puzzle. Unwind from everyday stress, find your flow state, and deliver your payload across 50 precision levels. Easy to learn, brutal to master.

release_games.name: Brush duel
release_games.description: Real-time 1v1 art battles: two players get the same painting and five minutes to recreate it, and the game decides whose work is closer to the original. Masterpieces and memes, duels with friends and solo practice.

release_games.name: Northrealm Tribes
release_games.description: Build a Viking village, manage resources and guide families through generations. Develop production chains, trade with visiting merchants and defend your settlement against longship raids. Join an online guild to strengthen a shared clan base and wage asynchronous guild wars.

release_games.name: Finding Words
release_games.description: Open a magical storybook and find the words that bring its tales to life. Complete 50 word-search puzzles across ten funny fantasy stories, fill in the missing passages and collect charming stickers, one discovery at a time. Play at your own pace.

release_games.name: Deep Drift Fishing
release_games.description: Drop your line into the uncharted abyss! Dodge exotic aquatic fauna on your descent, snag high-value specimens on the reel-up, and survive encounters with mythical Apex predators. Upgrade your winch, harness burst nets, and unlock new oceans in this fast-paced arcade deep-sea fishing adventure.

release_games.name: RULEBALL
release_games.description: A football roguelite where you choose the rules and the players play themselves. Add balls, freeze the pitch and build a squad for the chaos. Lead your club through Sunday, Pro and Legend, choose your route to the final and keep chasing cups.

release_games.name: Grind or Die
release_games.description: Grind or Die is an endless, top-down arena survival game packed with demonic hordes, brutal bosses, randomized upgrades, and character-specific powers. Build your warrior, time your dashes, and fight through waves that grow increasingly unforgiving.

release_games.name: Lodebreaker
release_games.description: Lodebreaker is a colorful mining idle clicker. Smash mineral-rich rocks, upgrade your pickaxe, and recruit a crew that keeps digging while you're away. Discover rare specimens, beat timed Mega Blocks, and ascend for permanent bonuses as you push deeper.

release_games.name: Cheat Koi-Koi
release_games.description: A single-player koi-koi roguelite in a nighttime gambling den. Read your opponent, peek at hidden cards, and swap your way to victory. Get caught, pay a fine. Choose tricks and upgrades, buy tools, and beat the den's owner Ririka for the prize.

release_games.name: Beatrice
release_games.description: You are sent to inspect an old abandoned estate before its demolition. Locals refuse to speak about the place, only whispering of a doll named Beatrice left behind. Uncover the horrible events that took place chapter by chapter, solve the mysteries, and find a way to escape. Are you brave enough?

release_games.name: Swaplines
release_games.description: A simple, easy puzzle game: gather each color of ball onto its matching LINE. The more you play, the more the tricks click. Endless, randomly generated puzzles, and a cute little town in the background that grows with every puzzle you solve.

release_games.name: WebBound Solitaire
release_games.description: A Spider Solitaire game with a journey. Climb a 116-level campaign across 29 unique zones, beat boss deals, earn up to 4 stars per level, collect relics and themes, and rank up from Novice to Legend. Or relax with Freeplay, Endless runs and a new Daily Spider every day.

release_games.name: Slitherlink: Line Logic
release_games.description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you connect dots to make one loop, using the numbers as clues. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 12,000 more, Easy to Expert.

release_games.name: Welcome To HillVeil
release_games.description: An atmospheric 3D puzzle exploration game about cheering up the lovely folks of HillVeil and making memories that last a lifetime! . . . . . what is it hiding?

release_games.name: Knockout Kiss💋
release_games.description: Five women have gone missing across a neon-lit city. Fight your way through 15 missions with dead-simple one-button combat: tap to strike, hold to charge, release. Every victory brings her closer and unlocks uncensored reward scenes. 18+ only.

release_games.name: CRUSH LOAD
release_games.description: Pilot an armoured mech through fifteen minutes of the horde. Choose where to move and what to pick up as your weapons fire automatically. Seven zones, seven colossi, twenty-one weapon lines: equip five, evolve them, and push one to its apex.

release_games.name: Sloptoberfest
release_games.description: A chaotic festival tent simulator for up to 4 players. Run your own Oktoberfest beer tent, serve beer and food, expand your business, hire staff, brew your own beer, and sabotage the competition.

release_games.name: Superpower Rally: Home Guard
release_games.description: Relaxing light roguelike tower defense! Roguelike progression, plant hero growth, selectable super plants, day/night modes. Awakened plants vs zombies—collect plants, unlock skills, upgrade sun economy, defend your home. Low-spec friendly for tower defense and roguelike Build fans.

release_games.name: Afternoon Paws
release_games.description: Run a cozy idle café with 24 cats. Feed, groom and dress them, watch friendships grow, and explore nine story chapters. Upgrade bowls, unlock four foods, invite familiar rare guests and make photo keepsakes. Enjoy five café styles or keep your cats close in a companion window.

release_games.name: GemLoop
release_games.description: GemLoop is a match-3 incremental game featuring continuous progression through earning money and unlocking skills in an extensive skill tree.

release_games.name: Just Pancake Simulator
release_games.description: A short physics-based cooking game about making pancakes for someone you love. Flip, burn, drop, and somehow serve the perfect stack.

release_games.name: Parry X Break
release_games.description: Designed for high replay value and quick restarts, Parry X Break is a fast paced spin on the brick breaker genre where the ball goes faster every time you parry it. Parrying speeds up the ball, raises your point multiplier, and levels up your ball so you can break locked bricks.

release_games.name: Bloom
release_games.description: A puzzle-platformer about an innocent, curious being exploring the planets of Bloom, planting seeds and sprouting flowers with its song. Sing! Use your voice and impact the ecosystem that birthed you, and become one with the cosmos.

release_games.name: Armament Inc
release_games.description: Build a global arms empire in this idle tycoon. Research weapons, automate production, ship contracts across a live world map, out-maneuver rivals in diplomacy, and flex your fortune in a private mansion on your way to the top.

release_games.name: BitVoid
release_games.description: A 2D survival game where you evolve your code by absorbing data and fighting malware. Survive solo, in co-op, or in multiplayer, take on powerful bosses, collect collectibles, and complete the Codex as you explore a hostile cyberspace to the beat of electronic music.

release_games.name: Random & Unfair Battlefields
release_games.description: Random & Unfair Battlefields is a chaotic fantasy RTS where you barely control your own army. Pick a faction, muster your forces, and issue decrees (spells) to tilt the odds in your favour. Randomly generated maps and daily events mean no two battles play out the same.

release_games.name: Dino Dome: Tidy Up!
release_games.description: Dino Dome: Tidy Up! is a cozy first-person organization game about restoring a giant indoor toy dome. Pick up thousands of colorful dinosaurs, match each one to its proper cupboard, and turn a wonderfully messy floor into a calm, complete collection.

release_games.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire
release_games.description: Build a sports agency empire from your hometown up. Sign stars across basketball, football, baseball and hockey, negotiate under real salary-cap rules, fill your trophy case with career honors, and climb the monthly global leaderboard. One price. Twenty seasons. Zero microtransactions.

release_games.name: Trapoint
release_games.description: A roguelite base-defense game where your traps decide where enemies walk — and where they fall. Block a chokepoint so the whole wave comes down one road, line it with traps, and draft a new one from three cards after every wave. They won't make it easy: they dig through walls and tear traps apart.

release_games.name: Neon Apocalypsis
release_games.description: Neon Apocalypsis is a single-player, top-down 45° survival shooter. In 2031, Neon Nation falls to a cataclysm of zombies and monstrous beasts. Loot and modify firearms, armor and vehicles, build automated turrets, defend your encampment, and uncover the conspiracy behind the monster uprising.

release_games.name: Beastwood Haven
release_games.description: Collect forest creatures, build a thriving camp, assign jobs, and send expedition teams into automated turn-based battles in search of materials and mysterious eggs.

release_games.name: House Rules 21
release_games.description: Blackjack, but every dealer plays by their own house rules. Work your way through nine dealers, each bending the rules of 21 in a different direction, build your bankroll, and unlock the modifiers, side bets, and card backs that turn a simple hand into a full run.

release_games.name: Phasewright
release_games.description: A pulse crosses one cell per tick — the longer way arrives later. From that one rule you build machines out of light: lay conduits, split colours, hit the beat. Quiet, untimed, free.

release_games.name: HENTAI CHAMELEON
release_games.description: "Hentai Chameleon" puts your hide and seek skills to the test! Play as a sexy anime girl, pose, and paint yourself to hide in the level's environment. Or play as the male team to find the girls, and catch them to get their "special reward"💕💦Up to 8 players supported! Paint yourself and blend away!

release_games.name: Quartermark
release_games.description: Your party fights on its own. Who stands in it and what they carry is your call — and that is the whole game. 16 heroes, 9 keywords that chain into gold combos, 100 maps, 440 grotesque 3D monsters, 100 bosses and an upgrade ladder that can destroy your best item.

release_games.name: Crypt Survivor
release_games.description: Fight through a cursed crypt in this action roguelite. Master unique classes, combine powerful upgrades, and claim the abilities of fallen bosses. Battle across five deadly floors to break the curse, or push your build to its limit in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: Frog Frog Parkour
release_games.description: Take control of a frog in a fast-paced arcade parkour game. Charge each jump, launch yourself across challenging courses, collect coins, and race against your own ghost to beat your best times. Easy to start, difficult to master.

release_games.name: Thirteen Provinces · Hanren
release_games.description: Build a Three Kingdoms deck in this turn-based strategy card game. Battle AI, invite friends or find opponents through room matchmaking. Share the field and Strategy Points in 2v2, adapt to the seasons, and collect cards, cosmetics and stories of allies fighting side by side.

release_games.name: zenaimu
release_games.description: A slime pen for your desktop! Make your workspace 10x cuter with slimes that bounce around while you use your PC. Try your luck at the gachaclaw each day to get new slimes for your collection!

release_games.name: Her Revenge
release_games.description: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK

release_games.name: My friend pig
release_games.description: A chaotic co-op adventure for 2-4 players where you play as hungry pigs who have just escaped their pen in search of pumpkins. Snatch pumpkins, outrun an enraged farmer, leap through mysterious portals, and survive the strangest adventure of your piggy life.

release_games.name: Ice Cream Hero
release_games.description: Ice Cream Hero is a sweet tower defense challenge for one to eight players. Team up with friends or play solo as Nilla, a brave little ice cream hero defending his land’s precious Sprinkle Bank from hungry silverware, chaotic waves, and big bad bosses!

release_games.name: Curse of Baghdad
release_games.description: A top-down military shooter with a rich story about brotherhood when surviving an unknown curse. Face the odds and escape with your life from this unprecedented threat that lurks in the shadows of Baghdad, Iraq.

release_games.name: EDO: Endless Demon Omen
release_games.description: Lead a small warband through a haunted province in this action roguelite. Move and dodge while your troops fight automatically, recruit survivors, and capture castles. Unlock commanders, combine run buffs, and face the growing Yokai threat.

release_games.name: Anomaly Jobs : Death Row
release_games.description: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.

release_games.name: Softboiled
release_games.description: A challenging physics-based precision platformer about a fragile egg. Crafted for hardboiled players.

release_games.name: PuzzMao〜Puzzle and Magical Overlord〜
release_games.description: Heartwarming Fantasy × Falling-Block Puzzle Game PuzzMao～Puzzle and Magical Overlord～ is a falling-block puzzle game set in a fantasy world where you battle for the throne of Demon Lord! Defeat the advancing enemies with simple rules and exhilarating puzzles!

release_games.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
release_games.description: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

release_games.name: Halloween Tidy Up
release_games.description: Race through a whimsical haunted manor, gather matching clutter into your satchel, return every treasure to its proper place, and banish mischievous spirits before the clock strikes midnight.

release_games.name: Mahjong Traveler
release_games.description: Draw three tiles, flip one, walk that many steps. Build your tile bag like a deck, then beat each boss in a real game of mahjong. Mahjong Traveler is a cozy HD-2D pixel roguelite: cross the Four Winds Isles, patch the broken rules of mahjong, and reach the Sealed Abyss before the seal gives way.

release_games.name: The Marquee: Lights. Camera. Legacy.
release_games.description: Build a film studio from the ground up, create original movies, manage talent and production, compete for audiences, and turn unexpected successes into a cinematic legacy.

release_games.name: Patients
release_games.description: Psychological horror with a retro atmosphere,solo or co-op experience for 2 or more players,Inventory and, resource management, interactive and explorable environment, unpredictable events

release_games.name: Same Apartment
release_games.description: Same Apartment is a story-driven psychological horror game unfolding across twelve days. Explore a constantly changing apartment, follow disturbing broadcasts, read notes, and confront fragmented memories as the boundary between reality and delusion slowly disappears.

release_games.name: The Harbour Between Us
release_games.description: A free cozy desktop fishing game about a little harbour and a love that never grew old. Catch fish, enjoy the sunset market, pet the cats, and follow unsent letters to help two old sweethearts find their way back to each other.

release_games.name: CHAMBER: ATOM BREAKER INC
release_games.description: A reactor made of breakable pixels. Stir the atoms with your hand, fuse them up the ladder, and chew through the chamber wall layer by layer until the fuel runs out. The playing field is what you spend.

release_games.name: Howling Woods
release_games.description: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

release_games.name: Insufferedere: Kuudere
release_games.description: You asked for a tsundere. God gave you a kuudere. A short, choice-heavy comedy romance VN about awkward conversations, anime nonsense, and slowly getting closer to the quiet girl sent to you by God.

release_games.name: Phantom Fleet
release_games.description: Command Hollow King in a naval action roguelite. Sink ships, harvest souls, and recruit a ghost fleet. Shape your build with upgrade cards and five automatic skill slots. Break blockades across ten seas, then rise stronger after sinking with permanent shipyard upgrades.

release_games.name: Tsudoi
release_games.description: A cozy hangout for up to 16 friends in a yakiniku restaurant. Grill meat at your booth, order from the table tablet, pour drinks and just talk with proximity voice chat. No winning, no scores, no events: just time spent together.

release_games.name: Mall Corp
release_games.description: John is an ordinary security guard at a shopping mall who has been working there for 40 years. It was supposed to be just another routine shift. But this night hits different.

release_games.name: Number Go Up
release_games.description: Number Go Up is a clicker, incremental game. It is exactly how it sounds, click buttons, buy upgrades, ascend, rebirth, reset your progress incrementally. And watch as the number on your screen rises faster and faster, achieving new heights. Throw on a video and relax as you watch your Number Go Up.

release_games.name: Trolley Problem Is Not Problem
release_games.description: A trolley-problem roguelite where everything you hit becomes a train car. Pull the lever, grow your train, plow through five tracks at once, and ram giant bosses with everything you've coupled.

release_games.name: Recycled
release_games.description: Recycled is a calm first-person co-op game about clearing a landfill. Pick up trash from four towers of 34,027 physical items, take things apart at the workbench, sort every piece into the right bin, press bales and drive forklifts and a tower crane. Solo or with up to 3 friends.

release_games.name: ROGRID
release_games.description: Minesweeper-style deduction meets roguelike dungeon crawling. Read the colors and shapes of clue blocks to uncover treasure among monsters and traps. Combine classes, skills, and artifacts, and manage health and action points to venture deeper.

release_games.name: Unlucky
release_games.description: A pile of identical slippers. Some explode. You're told how many, never which. Pick one up, look a friend in the eye, and throw. Or throw it at yourself and pray — prayer is a real item, along with an egg, a clown and somebody's mom. Online 2-4 players. Bring friends you can afford to lose.

release_games.name: Resonance
release_games.description: Resonance is a relaxing virtual handpan experience. Play intuitively with your keyboard, explore a variety of scales, shape your sound with effects and ambience, record and share what you create. A peaceful way to unwind after a long day.

release_games.name: Liberation Through Hearing
release_games.description: An interactive opera based on computer game technologies. An audio-visual, large-scale work that combines a dramatic story, taking place in digital media, with game-like elements. Hand drawings and composed music constitute the main fabric of the opera.

release_games.name: Futa Fitness 🤸‍♀️
release_games.description: Kyla is a hot blonde chick, the kind guys stare at in the gym. But what has her so captivated is her idol, Mara, and Mara’s exposed futa cock! If only she could get her hands – and mouth! – on that fine thick meat! Mara’s a serious gym fiend, but can Kyla convince her to try another type of workout?

release_games.name: Tall Orders
release_games.description: Tall Orders is a co-op platforming game where you and a friend play as small gnomes tending to a wizard's potion shop for the day. Work together to overcome your size, find the right ingredients, and brew potions. But beware, handling the ingredients may cause strange side effects!

release_games.name: Universal Tidy Up
release_games.description: A first-person puzzle game where tidying is the puzzle. Sort items into their correct place and solve puzzles across 20+ stages. This game features a mix of calm tidying and organizing puzzles.

release_games.name: 万古仙途
release_games.description: 览凡仙迢迢道境，观万灵碌碌浮生。 从练气起步，在修炼、经营、战斗与收集之间建立自己的成长循环；当此世仙途抵达瓶颈，便以重修换取永久仙缘，让下一世走得更远。

release_games.name: Whispers of the Night
release_games.description: A dark fantasy visual novel with turn-based RPG combat. Uncover why a town seals its nights, make choices its people remember, and survive fights decided by energy, status effects and equipment sets rather than reflexes. Playable in English and Turkish.

release_games.name: HELLBENT
release_games.description: HELLBENT is a souls like inspired game where you play as a knight of the Heavenly Order tasked with defeating a lord of hell who resides in purgatory.

release_games.name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
release_games.description: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

release_games.name: Big Dig
release_games.description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!

release_games.name: Todd is Late
release_games.description: Todd is Late is a FMV point and click hidden-object game that pits you not only against the clock, but also against your own ability to plan and adapt with every attempt. Help guide Todd out the door with everything he needs in time for his big day at work.

release_games.name: SummitJourney
release_games.description: A little cat keeps climbing while you get on with your day. Keep it in a transparent desktop corner, enable automatic hiking and Do Not Disturb, then return to trail stories and finds. Idle and offline progress, optional repeat climbs, and about 150 real-world peaks await.

release_games.name: Dawnreach: Veil of the Breach
release_games.description: Thrilling battles in a dark fantasy world. Endless loot: collect, upgrade, and optimize your equipment. Character progression through experience and powerful items. Dangerous areas filled with enemies, traps, and secrets. One epic goal: Conquer the Breach.

release_games.name: Warding Witches
release_games.description: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

release_games.name: Scribble Tanks
release_games.description: Scribble Tanks is a survival roguelite on a sketch-styled 3D battlefield on graph paper. Fight zombie hordes, tanks and bosses, build your arsenal, reclaim besieged regions, and face the final boss—or keep fighting in Endless Mode.

release_games.name: RetroHub
release_games.description: A 1994 interactive-TV terminal, drawn pixel by pixel. Dial a number and play: backgammon, Yum dice, hangman, bowling, pinball, brick-breaker, Bizz-Billes… Solo, with friends around one screen, or online.

release_games.name: Headbutt Dino
release_games.description: A roguelite deckbuilder about a headbutting dinosaur. I wanted the thrill of blasting obstacles away, not dodging them. The higher your combo, the denser they get, and active cards are there to just feel good to fire off. Every stage ends with a boss. Ten stages to a run, as currently designed.

release_games.name: Crypto Market Rivals
release_games.description: Find your trading style in a single-player game with simulated funds. Explore markets, revisit crypto history, build a Wild run, and grow a career at your own pace.

release_games.name: GRIDMINE
release_games.description: GRIDMINE is a short, retro tower defense built around incremental progression. Survive for as long as possible, then return to your skill tree to spend extracted resources on tower-based upgrades and abilities.

release_games.name: First Principles: A Calculus Platformer
release_games.description: Run and jump across the graphs of real functions. Every level is a curve — its derivative shapes the platforms and hazards. 40+ stages from parabolas to Riemann sums, AP Calculus BC, physics, and aerospace curves, ending in a Mandelbrot boss. A platformer that teaches real calculus.

release_games.name: Dicey Desk
release_games.description: There's a die on your taskbar. It charges while you type, so the more work you get done the more you get to roll. Collect an unreasonable number of dies, trade your spares up into rarer ones, and watch it tumble across your desktop instead of finishing that email.

release_games.name: Nothing Simulator
release_games.description: A game about doing absolutely nothing. Stare at a black screen, watch a timer and prove that time is still passing

release_games.name: The Debt We Sow
release_games.description: Grow crops, automate your farm, unlock powerful systems, and confront an ever-growing debt in a story-driven incremental farming game.

release_games.name: Volleyball Mania
release_games.description: Volleyball Mania is a 3D beach and indoor volleyball game. Pass, set, spike, read the block, aim past the defender, and finish the rally. Take on the World Tour across three stadiums, or challenge a friend online.

release_games.name: Take Good Care of Your Cassava
release_games.description: A tiny Brazilian June festival that dances on your desktop. Mandioca dances on her own while you work: every step earns Cheer, Cheer brings guests.

release_games.name: Looks Like It Fits
release_games.description: A cargo-packing puzzle about making an awkward load survive the road. Keep ice cold, warm a dragon egg and strap down fragile parcels. Study the route, arrange your truck bed, then watch your plan face bumps, braking and changing weather across 40 deliveries.

release_games.name: Hero Football Manager
release_games.description: Run a small football club where ordinary players can wake up with superpowers. Train the squad, hire staff, upgrade the ground and keep the books. Then watch your plan play out in pixel-art matches.

release_games.name: GRID64
release_games.description: Minimalist pixel-art chess in pure black and white. Solve mate puzzles, face an engine that thinks up to 8 moves ahead, or play strangers worldwide in rated matches and arena tournaments where the champion wins a golden card.

release_games.name: Buying Time
release_games.description: skill-based bets! You have a limited amount of time but with this you can win more. Use powerful upgrades to further increase your time pool because when it hits zero, it's game over. Things are not as simple as they seem.

release_games.name: Neon Crossing
release_games.description: Dodge traffic, find the right opening, and beat your high score. Choose one of three anime girls, unlock new character portraits, and climb the Steam leaderboard.

release_games.name: Belgo Odyssey
release_games.description: Belgo Odyssey is an absurdly Belgian 2D action-arcade game. Aboard the airship Albert, travel across the country, battle Sputnik drones, Panzercopies, bizarre creatures, and very Belgian bosses. Collect beers, eat fries, and try to save Belgium.

release_games.name: Through the Void: Echoes
release_games.description: Not a short incremental: a full action RPG built for hundreds of hours. 3 classes, 9 subclasses with deep skill trees, and 9 more skills to level — woodcutting, mining, blacksmithing, and more. Real-time combat, Void Tower, Ascension, Softcore or Hardcore.

release_games.name: Winter Creatures 2
release_games.description: Winter Creatures 2 is the sequel to the original 3D puzzle game, taking you to an unexplored world blanketed in snow and shrouded in mystery. It is home to little creatures that need your help!

release_games.name: Court of Lies
release_games.description: Lies are easier to tell than to hide. In this 5–10 player medieval deduction game you sit at the same table, speak, and watch the hands that seal every decree. Some among you serve the Dark Heir — and they want the crown to fall.

release_games.name: Tales of the Immortal Path
release_games.description: One sword breaks all arts, one thought attains immortality. Tales of the Immortal Path is an ink-wash xianxia single-player card roguelike. Countless artifacts and cards. Trample the heavens and seek the Dao of immortality!

release_games.name: DEADLUCK V

Lie, steal and larp over proximity chat.
